Blockchain Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Blockchain Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $140,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Blockchain Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade decentralized applications (dApps), smart contract platforms, and blockchain-integrated backend services supporting financial services, digital asset management, and enterprise transaction processing. This role focuses on building secure, scalable blockchain solutions that integrate seamlessly with cloud-native microservices and traditional enterprise applications.
You will work closely with solution architects, security engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to develop smart contracts, blockchain APIs, digital wallet integrations, tokenization platforms, and secure transaction processing systems. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in blockchain protocols, smart contract development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining strong software engineering fundamentals.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop secure smart contracts for enterprise blockchain applications using Solidity or other smart contract languages.
  • Build scalable backend services that interact with blockchain networks for transaction processing, asset management, and identity verification.
  • Develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs to expose blockchain functionality to web and mobile applications.
  • Design blockchain data models, token standards, and transaction workflows for high-volume enterprise systems.
  • Integrate enterprise applications with Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, or other blockchain platforms.
  • Develop secure wallet integrations, digital signature workflows, and key management solutions.
  • Implement blockchain event listeners, indexing services, and off-chain processing components.
  • Build scalable microservices using .NET Core, Java, or Node.js that interact with blockchain networks.
  • Optimize smart contracts for gas efficiency, scalability, and transaction throughput.
  • Perform smart contract audits, security testing, and vulnerability assessments before production deployments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy blockchain infrastructure across Azure or AWS cloud environments.
  • Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and production support activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex blockchain network issues, transaction failures, synchronization problems, and production incidents.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade distributed applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on blockchain development experience delivering production blockchain solutions.
  • Strong experience developing smart contracts using Solidity and Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible networks.
  • Hands-on experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, or Quorum.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js or backend development using C#/.NET Core or Java.
  • Experience building decentralized applications (dApps) with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, Merkle trees, and distributed ledger concepts.
  • Experience implementing ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, or custom token standards.
  • Experience integrating wallets such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, or enterprise custody platforms.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, WebSockets, and blockchain RPC interfaces.
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management.
  • Experience deploying applications on Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting skills in production environments.
  • Experience working within Agile Scrum development teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing enterprise blockchain solutions for financial services, healthcare, insurance, or supply chain industries.
  • Hands-on experience with Hyperledger Fabric chaincode development using Go or Java.
  • Experience with Layer-2 scaling solutions including Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism.
  • Familiarity with Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Multi-Party Computation (MPC), or privacy-preserving blockchain technologies.
  • Experience implementing decentralized identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC).
  • Knowledge of blockchain security standards, smart contract auditing tools, and common vulnerabilities such as reentrancy, overflow, front-running, and flash loan attacks.
  • Experience using Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, Ganache, Brownie, or Remix IDE.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience integrating blockchain applications with enterprise identity providers including Azure Active Directory or OAuth.
  • Blockchain certifications or contributions to open-source blockchain projects are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a team building a next-generation enterprise blockchain platform supporting:
  • Digital asset tokenization and lifecycle management
  • Smart contract-driven business workflows
  • Enterprise wallet and digital identity integration
  • Real-time blockchain event processing
  • Secure multi-signature transaction approval systems
  • Blockchain analytics and reporting dashboards
  • Cloud-native microservices deployed on Azure and AWS
  • High-availability distributed systems supporting millions of secure transactions annually

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll contribute to architecture, development, deployment, security, and operational excellence across mission-critical blockchain solutions.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Meet the Team

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a safer and more resilient digital world with an end-to-end full stack platform made for a hybrid, multi-cloud world. Leading enterprises use our unified security and observability platform to keep their digital systems secure and reliable. Come help organizations be their best, while you reach new heights with a team that has your back.

Do you want to make an impact and expand your sales knowledge and learn from the best? Are you passionate about groundbreaking technology and help businesses think differently? If you answered yes then we might have a home here for you at Splunk! The Inside Sales Representative will be responsible for expanding and growing territories for Splunk. You will use your sales, negotiation and leadership skills to prospect, and conduct lead generation techniques and sell Splunk's award-winning software into well-known/ brand named companies. You have a consistent record of selling software or services and you know how to build beneficial, positive relationships with customers.

Your Impact

  • Follow up with inbound leads and provide status updates through the company CRM system.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and lead generation.
  • Qualify leads and schedule product demos for customers.
  • Display a real passion for running accounts by building and fostering client relationships through personalized contact, understanding of client's needs, and ability to communicate solution values of products and services.
  • Accurately forecast opportunities based upon realistic assessments.
  • Meet/exceed assigned revenue goals.
  • Partner with field sales representatives in various geo/territories. Support attendance to all field marketing events to include, but not limited to Splunk Lives, our National Users Conference and all regional trade shows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least one year of sales experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling enterprise IT solutions (BI, data analytics, security software, risk management software or networking performance).
  • Previously worked in software company.
  • Developed and cultivated new business and managed the entire sales cycle from lead generation to close
  • Proven track record of exceeding annual sales quotas.
  • Technical experience using CRM system, Word, Excel, and SalesForce.
  • Prioritized and completed multiple tasks by consistently meeting deadlines

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $109,000.00 to $137,700.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

New York City Metro Area:

$114,000.00 - $165,800.00

Non-Metro New York state & Washington state:

$109,000.00 - $158,300.00

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Substation Commissioning Intern

Position Location: Remote - work from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major airport.
Education / Experience Requirements: Must be actively pursuing a Bachelors / Masters Engineering Degree or similar

Travel Requirements: Up to 75% domestic travel; relocation may be considered for long-term project needs. Must have a valid driver’s license.

JOB SUMMARY

The Commissioning Intern is focused on gaining foundational knowledge and hands-on experience in commissioning. This role provides technical support in inspection, validation, and testing of electrical and mechanical equipment.

The Commissioning Intern I will primarily assist senior team members, following structured test scripts, setting up test equipment, and ensuring compliance with safety and reporting standards.

The Commissioning Intern will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. They will work under immediate supervision.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Assist with On-Site Inspection, Testing & Validation (50%)

  • Observe and participate in factory witness testing
  • Observe startup activities
  • Learn to use technical equipment to perform testing
  • Observe and learn about functional testing of equipment and electrical, mechanical and controls systems
  • Troubleshoot system components

Assist in the Development of Testing Plans & Procedures (20%)

  • Assist in the development of commissioning plans
  • Assist with preparation of pre-functional checklists
  • Assist with preparation of functional performance test scripts

Assist in the Review of Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (15%)

  • Learn to review shop drawings and submittals
  • Learn to review sequence of operations
  • Assist in commissioning focused design reviews

Reporting (15%)

  • Assist in the preparation of project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Assist in preparation and contributes to final commissioning report
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL OF THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

  • Knowledge of electrical, mechanical and controls system principles
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools.
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Up to 75%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.

About Foodsmart:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the Role:

  • Increase the velocity of the sales contracting process while keeping the company safe.
  • Act as a business-minded thought partner to the sales, client development, marketing, operations and other teams, contributing to both the legal and the business aspects of contract negotiations.
  • Build processes, create/improve templates, and drive the adoption of tools and technology (including A.I.) to increase the efficiency and quality of the contracting process.

  • Provide legal counsel on contractual obligations, risk mitigation, and dispute resolution related to commercial transactions.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws and company policies in all contractual engagements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including finance, security and operations, to support business objectives through effective vendor contract review and management.
  • Develop and implement contract templates, playbooks, and best practices to streamline the contracting process.
  • Manage relevant processes and tools, e.g. vendor approval process through Jira, contract management tool, and advising on legal/contracting aspects of Salesforce implementation.

  • Train and educate internal stakeholders on contract-related legal risks and best practices.
  • As a member of a small legal team, there will be opportunities to flex and lean into other areas as desired/needed, e.g. intellectual property, privacy advice, employment matters, and to grow into a more generalist role.

You are:

  • Flexible and able to sort through ambiguity
  • Detail-oriented, but don’t lose the forest to the trees

The Assistant Controller will serve as a trusted partner to Finance and business leadership and help build a faster, more scalable accounting operation. This role offers the flexibility to work remotely within the continental United States. Candidates located in the Jacksonville, Florida area are strongly preferred.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, including governance, reconciliations, journal entries, supporting schedules, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee consolidated financial statements, balance sheet and cash flow reporting, variance analysis, revenue accounting, and executive management reporting.
  • Provide senior oversight of complex accounting matters, including ASC 606 revenue recognition, leases, joint ventures, business combinations, and acquisition integration.
  • Lead U.S. GAAP financial statement audits and Federal Acquisition Regulation overhead audits, and support state Department of Transportation indirect cost submissions.
  • Own accounting policies and the internal control framework, including control design, testing, documentation, reconciliation standards, and risk assessment.
  • Lead finance transformation, enterprise resource planning, process automation, and responsible artificial intelligence adoption across accounting workflows.
  • Partner across Finance, Tax, Legal, Enterprise Applications, Human Resources, Operations, and business leadership to resolve issues and improve financial processes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop accounting professionals while establishing clear accountability, performance expectations, and succession plans.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with at least 12 years of related experience, or a master’s degree with at least 10 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least five years of progressive experience leading or supervising accounting professionals.
  • Demonstrated ownership of monthly close and financial reporting within corporate accounting, public accounting, technical accounting, consolidations, revenue accounting, accounting operations, or accounting policy.
  • Experience applying U.S. GAAP, maintaining internal controls, managing external audits, and preparing executive- and Board-level reporting.
  • Proven success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives such as acquisition integration, system implementation, or process transformation.
  • Executive-level communication skills and the ability to translate complex accounting and system topics into clear, actionable insights.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Public Accountant credential strongly preferred.
  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Deltek Vision or Vantagepoint, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience in architecture and engineering or another project-based professional services environment.
  • Public accounting experience with a Big Four, national, or regional firm.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including purchase accounting and post-acquisition integration.

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Please view Equal Employment Opportunity Posters provided by OFCCP here.

Please note: no agency representation or submissions will be recognized for this vacancy. Candidates should apply directly to this role to be considered. It is the responsibility of all third-party recruiting and employment agencies to know and adhere to our recruiting policy.

The Company

Employee-owned, RS&H is one of the nation’s leading architecture, engineering, and consulting firms, with associates who work hard every day to create tomorrow together. We offer an exceptional journey from start to future. Our integrated teams translate experience into insight, turn challenges into opportunities, and build relationships that are as strong as the buildings and infrastructure we deliver together. We attribute our success to our unwavering commitment to our core values: integrity, accountability, curiosity, and teamwork.

raw.title: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Credit Loss Ratio
  • Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
  • Portfolio Delinquency Rates
  • Operational Loss Events
  • Regulatory Findings and Remediation
  • Fraud Loss Reduction
  • AML Compliance Effectiveness
  • Cyber Risk Incident Metrics
  • Risk Appetite Compliance
  • Capital and Liquidity Adequacy
  • Audit and Regulatory Examination Outcomes

raw.title: Account Executive - SAP Cloud ERP
raw.excerpt: who we areEvora Group is a specialist SAP consulting and services partner with deep expertise in SAP Cloud ERP transformation.
raw.description:
who we are

Evora Group is a specialist SAP consulting and services partner with deep expertise in SAP Cloud ERP transformation. We help mid-market and enterprise organizations across North America unlock operational efficiency and scalability through SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP BTP, and adjacent SAP solutions. We are a trusted partner within the SAP ecosystem and are growing our North American sales presence to capitalize on significant market demand.

We are looking for a driven, experienced Account Executive to own and grow our SAP Cloud ERP sales motion in North America. This is a high-impact individual contributor role built around three core pillars: owning complex enterprise sales cycles end-to-end, cultivating deep relationships within the SAP field organization, and proactively generating your own pipeline. This is not an overlay or a channel role - you will carry a quota and be expected to build and close business.

who we are looking for

Full SAP Cloud ERP Sales Cycle Ownership

  • Manage end-to-end sales cycles for SAP Cloud ERP opportunities - from initial qualification through discovery, solution design, business case development, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop account and territory strategies that maximize win rates and average deal size.
  • Work cross-functionally with presales, delivery, and leadership to craft compelling, customer-specific proposals and demonstrations.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene and forecasting in CRM (HubSpot), with a consistent methodology across stages.
  • Meet and exceed annual quota targets; operate with a sense of urgency and accountability throughout the quarter.
SAP Ecosystem Relationship Building
  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with SAP Territory Managers, Account Executives, and Partner Business Managers across your assigned North American territory.
  • Position Evora Group as the go-to implementation and transformation partner for SAP-led Cloud ERP opportunities - ensuring inbound referrals and co-sell motions flow to you.
  • Participate in SAP field events, QBRs, partner days, and industry meetups to deepen relationships and stay visible within the SAP ecosystem
  • Develop a systematic approach to tracking SAP territory alignment and ensuring warm, reciprocal relationships at the local and regional level.
  • Collaborate on joint account plans with SAP field teams where opportunities exist for coordinated pursuit.
Self-Generated Pipeline & Market Intelligence
  • Proactively source new opportunities through your personal network, outbound prospecting, referrals, and strategic outreach - not solely through SAP-referred leads.
  • Monitor market intelligence for pipeline triggers: leadership changes, ERP system end-of-life signals, funding events, M&A activity, and organizational growth inflection points.
  • Represent Evora Group at industry conferences, SAP user groups (ASUG), trade shows, and networking events across North America.
  • Develop and execute account-based prospecting campaigns in collaboration with marketing to penetrate target verticals and accounts.
  • Build a reputation as a trusted SAP Cloud ERP advisor - leveraging thought leadership, social presence, and community engagement to drive awareness and inbound interest.

what you bring

Required Skills:

  • Energetic attitude with a passion to succeed in quota attainment and teamwork.
  • 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience, with at least 3 years selling Cloud solutions (S/4HANA Cloud, SAP ERP, ByDesign, or adjacent Cloud portfolio).
  • Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (typically 6–9 months) and closing six-to-seven figure deals.
  • Existing relationships within the SAP field organization - Territory Managers, Account Executives, or Partner channels - that can be activated from day one.
  • Strong hunter mentality: you can self-source pipeline and don't rely on inbound alone to hit your number.
  • Experience selling ERP transformations to C-suite buyers (CFO, COO, CIO) and navigating complex organizational buying processes.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot CRM and standard enterprise sales methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, discovery, executive presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to travel, up to 25% minimum, as needed within North America for customer meetings, SAP events, and industry conferences.
Preferred Skills:
  • SAP Partner certification, SAP Activate methodology knowledge, or formal SAP sales training.
  • Experience at an SAP reseller, VAR, or systems integrator (SI) environment.
  • Existing warm prospect network or book of business in North American mid-market or enterprise segments.
  • Familiarity with SAP partner program structures, deal registration, and co-sell motion mechanics.
  • Knowledge of key SAP Cloud ERP verticals: manufacturing, professional services, retail, or life sciences.

what we offer

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission - OTE commensurate with experience.
  • Generous PTO, comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage, and 401(k) with employer match.
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility and autonomy over how you manage your territory.
  • Access to Evora Group's SAP partnership resources, enablement, and technical presales support.
  • A collaborative, expert team with deep SAP delivery credibility behind every deal.
  • Clear career path as we scale our North American presence.
  • Company-supported attendance at key SAP and industry events.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement:
Evora IT Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

raw.description:
Somos a maior companhia tech brasileira para o agronegócio, conectando pessoas, soluções e tecnologia para transformar a gestão das empresas do setor. Nosso objetivo é simplificar processos complexos por meio de produtos digitais, principalmente nas áreas fiscal, contábil e regulatória.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Business Analyst com forte conhecimento fiscal e contábil, especialmente com domínio das mudanças trazidas pela Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS e novo modelo de tributação).

Mais do que conhecer a legislação, buscamos alguém que consiga propor soluções inovadoras dentro do produto, ajudando nossos clientes a atravessarem esse momento de transição com segurança. Essa pessoa terá papel estratégico em entender as novas regras, acompanhar o mercado, identificar oportunidades e transformar tudo isso em funcionalidades claras, eficientes e escaláveis.

Você fará parte de um time colaborativo, orientado a dados e focado em resultado, que valoriza autonomia, clareza na comunicação e protagonismo na construção do produto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na evolução do produto por meio da análise de processos fiscais e contábeis, identificação de melhorias e definição de soluções junto ao time de tecnologia e stakeholders.

Reforma Tributária e inovação no produto

  • Analisar as mudanças trazidas pela Reforma Tributária e identificar oportunidades de evolução no produto;
  • Propor soluções inovadoras que ajudem os clientes na transição para o novo modelo tributário;
  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado e soluções que estão sendo adotadas por outras empresas;
  • Traduzir as novas regras em funcionalidades claras, escaláveis e alinhadas com o produto;
  • Desenhar fluxos, regras de negócio e comportamentos do sistema considerando o novo modelo de tributação.

Métricas e análise de produto

  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto relacionadas às funcionalidades fiscais e contábeis;
  • Analisar adoção de funcionalidades, comportamento dos usuários e impacto das entregas;
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e indicadores;
  • Acompanhar evolução de métricas como uso de funcionalidades, redução de erros fiscais, eficiência de processos e valor gerado para o cliente.

Discovery e priorização

  • Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e análises de dados para identificar dores relacionadas a processos fiscais e contábeis;
  • Levantar impactos da Reforma Tributária no produto e nos clientes;
  • Apoiar na priorização das demandas com base em impacto regulatório, adoção e valor para o negócio.

Modelagem e especificação

  • Mapear processos fiscais e contábeis de ponta a ponta;
  • Elaborar fluxos, fluxogramas e diagramas UML (casos de uso, sequência e classe);
  • Escrever User Stories com critérios de aceite claros e testáveis;
  • Definir regras de negócio, validações, mensagens e comportamentos esperados das funcionalidades;
  • Apoiar na definição de integrações, APIs e regras de validação de dados fiscais.

Qualidade e entrega

  • Apoiar o time de QA na definição de cenários de teste;
  • Validar entregas com stakeholders e clientes;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das demandas dentro das sprints;
  • Garantir que as regras fiscais e contábeis estejam sendo aplicadas corretamente nas entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos como Business Analyst, Analista Fiscal, Analista Contábil ou função equivalente;
  • Conhecimento prático em rotinas fiscais;
  • Apuração de tributos;
  • Obrigações acessórias fiscais e contábeis;
  • Documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, MDF-e);
  • Conhecimento em Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo e novo modelo de tributação);
  • Capacidade de analisar a legislação e transformar em solução dentro do produto;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto ou análise de dados de uso de funcionalidades;
  • Experiência estruturando:
  • User Stories com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Regras de negócio detalhadas;
  • Fluxos e processos;
  • Experiência colaborando com times de tecnologia (back-end, front-end e QA);
  • Vivência com ferramentas como: Azure DevOps, Miro, , Notion, Excel ou similares;
  • Conhecimento básico de SQL ou leitura de modelos de dados.
  • Experiência com APIs e integrações, incluindo:
  • Entendimento de APIs REST;
  • Leitura e definição de payloads;
  • Uso de ferramentas como Swagger e Postman;

Diferenciais (muito valorizados para a vaga)

  • Experiência com sistemas fiscais ou contábeis;
  • Conhecimento em SPED (EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD, ECF, REINF);
  • Conhecimento em regras de XML de documentos fiscais;
  • Conhecimento em CST, CFOP, NCM e regras de tributação;
  • Experiência com produtos SaaS;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto, NPS ou análise de comportamento do usuário;
  • Vivência com projetos ligados à Reforma Tributária.

Soft skills que valorizamos

  • Clareza na comunicação e capacidade de explicar temas complexos de forma simples;
  • Pensamento analítico e visão sistêmica;
  • Organização e disciplina com documentação;
  • Proatividade e senso de prioridade;
  • Visão de produto e foco em solução;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.

raw.description:
EHS Support is a specialty environmental consulting firm that provides solutions to complex environmental, health, and safety challenges across a range of market sectors and industries. With experts located throughout the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and South Africa, we form long-lasting partnerships with our clients through a culture of excellence, innovation, work ethic, and integrity. We focus on hiring and retaining talented, motivated people who enjoy collaborating with and delivering value to our clients. Our team does more than identify problems— we provide solutions.

We are seeking a remote Senior Data Analyst to join the team.

Your Primary Responsibilities:

Technical Expertise and Execution

Primary responsibilities will fall within the Technical Expertise and Execution focus area, as part of the core technical team within the Remediation Service Line. Additional assignments will include providing technical support to projects across multiple service lines including Sediment & Risk Assessment, Business Services Group, Allocation & Litigation Support, and Potentially Responsible Parties. Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Assisting in the management of EHS Support’s centralized environmental data warehouse.
  • Assisting with development of standards and procedures for data management process improvements.
  • Developing agency-specific electronic data deliverables to comply with data submission requirements.
  • Actively communicating and coordinating with project managers, laboratories, and/or other team members to acquire data packages of varying formats to be imported to a centralized database system.
  • Obtaining, cleaning, reviewing, synthesizing, and visualizing environmental data in an organized and concise manner.
  • Generating and documenting reproducible scripts and tools to improve data cleaning and analysis processes.
  • Running, modifying, and developing reports and queries to ensure data quality and accuracy.
  • Developing clear, technically accurate data visualization work products to support analysis and presentation of multiple types of datasets.
  • Assisting in GIS and spatial data analysis as needed via custom R or other script generation for figure, table, and web map creation.
  • Supporting the preparation of expert reports for litigation purposes and preparation of products for expert testimony.
  • Acting as an advisor in developing budgets and proposals for large scale analytical chemistry, geoscience, and data management projects.
  • Coordinating with internal and external clients to provide data management solutions.
  • Engaging in technical writing to report findings and interpretations of data analysis to support investigation objectives.
  • Enhancing the technical capabilities of the team by expanding the knowledge base, improving internal processes, and developing innovative technical approaches.

General expectations of the technical role include:

  • Ability to adapt to a changing environment and handle multiple priorities, with ability to self-manage priorities, deadlines, and budgets
  • Capable of working both independently and in a team environment
  • Self-directed learner with critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Curiosity and an affinity for solving problems
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to technical and lay audiences
  • Attention to detail in terms of technical deliverables, plans, reports, etc.
  • Engage in independent learning via webinars, conferences, peer-reviewed publications, internal knowledge shares, strategic growth project tasks, etc.
  • Travel, as needed based on client and project needs. Travel is not expected to be a significant component of this role but may be necessary at times for client meetings or other project needs.

Clients & Growth

  • Client interaction, as required on projects.
  • Assist, as needed, in marketing existing and new clients, including site visits and general business development support as it relates to any of the above-mentioned activities.
  • Prepare proposals, scopes of work, and project summaries to support business development activities as appropriate for the projects you are involved in and in alignment with the Service Line goals.
  • Attend client meetings to assist in business development.
  • Work with client managers to expand our relationships to your contacts.

raw.description:
Was du bei uns bewegen kannst

  • Du baust die Infrastruktur, auf der Anwendungen zuverlässig laufen. Von der Konzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme hast du den späteren hochverfügbaren und skalierbaren Betrieb im Blick.

  • CI/CD-Pipelines, Deployment-Strategien und Automatisierungslösungen gestaltest du so, dass Teams schnell und sicher ausliefern können.

  • Observability-Stacks baust du auf und sorgst mit Monitoring, Logging und Alerting dafür, dass Probleme sichtbar werden, bevor sie Nutzer:innen betreffen.

  • Linux-basierte Systeme härtest du und automatisierst das Konfigurationsmanagement mit Terraform, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Tools. Security denkst du dabei von Anfang an mit.

  • Container und Kubernetes gehören zu deinem Alltag. Du betreibst Anwendungen in containerisierten Umgebungen und verstehst die Grundlagen der Orchestrierung.

  • Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du über fachliche Grenzen und Projektphasen hinweg maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für den Kunden, wobei du die Effizienz deiner Automatisierungs-Workflows durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI-Tools konsequent steigerst.

In unseren Projekten verwenden wir häufig folgende Technologien:

  • Linux, Systemd, containerd, Bash

  • OpenTofu, Ansible, Gitlab CI, Argo CD, Grafana Stack, Prometheus

  • Kubernetes, Helm, Trivy, Falco, Go

  • AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, STACKIT

Intern wie extern kannst du dich bei uns auf vielfältige Art einbringen: Deinen anfangs gewählten technologischen Schwerpunkt kannst du jederzeit verlagern. Als Expert:in im Bereich Engineering hast du außerdem die Möglichkeit, jüngere Kolleg:innen durch Mentoring zu unterstützen.

Requirements

Wer gut zu uns passen würde

Ob du ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich abgeschlossen hast, ist für uns nebensächlich – für uns zählen deine fachlichen Skills und deine Persönlichkeit:

  • Auf der Linux-Kommandozeile fühlst du dich zu Hause. Systemd, Networking, Storage und Prozessmanagement beherrschst du sicher.

  • CI/CD-Pipelines hast du bisher nicht nur genutzt, sondern selbst gebaut, optimiert und debuggt. Außerdem kannst du Infrastructure-as-Code routiniert einsetzen.

  • Du verfügst über tiefe Kenntnisse in der Containerisierung sowie deren Orchestrierung und bist routiniert darin, Anwendungen in entsprechenden Umgebungen effizient zu betreiben.

  • Wie Entwicklungsteams arbeiten, verstehst du und gestaltest Prozesse und Toolchains so, dass sie den Weg von der lokalen Entwicklung bis zum Production-Deployment vereinfachen.

  • Du setzt Coding-Assistenten und KI-basierte Automatisierung gezielt ein, um Arbeitsabläufe zu beschleunigen. Sei es bei der effizienten Erstellung von Ansible-Playbooks oder beim automatisierten Troubleshooting von Systemfehlern.

  • Du kannst ebenfalls komplexe technische Sachverhalte präzise analysieren und diese so aufbereiten, dass sie auch für nicht-technische Stakeholder verständlich und nachvollziehbar sind.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

raw.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University is seeking a highly analytical and customer-focused Flight Applications Systems Analyst to join the Information Technology department in a fully remote capacity. This position supports, maintains, and enhances the University’s core flight systems, including Talon ETA/RMS, SplashBI, and related applications and integrations.

The Flight Applications Systems Analyst provides application support, develops and maintains operational and analytical reports, writes and troubleshoots SQL queries, validates data, and investigates complex system issues. Working closely with academic and administrative departments, this role gathers business requirements, analyzes processes, and translates customer needs into effective reports, system enhancements, and sustainable technical solutions.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving, communication, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and deliver responsive customer service. Experience with SplashBI is preferred, but experience with comparable reporting platforms will be considered. Knowledge of higher education and/or flight operations is also beneficial.

This position offers the opportunity to support the University’s flight operations. The role is fully remote, with minimal travel; however, it requires 24/7 rotating on-call availability.

About us

For over 100 years, Embry-Riddle has been the world's leading aviation and aerospace university, educating more than 30,000 students across residential campuses in Daytona Beach, Florida, and Prescott, Arizona, as well as through a global network of Worldwide locations and online programs. With more than 165,000 alumni around the world, our impact reaches every corner of the aerospace, aviation, defense and technology industries.

Today, our faculty, researchers and professional staff are advancing innovation across aviation, space, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, autonomous systems and next-generation engineering. Working alongside industry leaders, government agencies and innovators, they are solving real-world challenges and shaping the technologies that will define tomorrow.

Whether you are an educator, researcher, administrator, technologist or industry professional, your work at Embry-Riddle will contribute to something bigger than a job. Join a community driven by discovery, purpose and excellence—and help shape the future of aerospace.

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy up to 18 days of paid leave in your first year, including 3 days granted upon hire and 15 days accrued throughout the year. You'll also receive 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day.
  • Tuition Coverage: Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.
  • Retirement Contributions: ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.
  • Personal Leave: Relax with 15 days of personal leave for non-exempt employees or 18 days for exempt full-time employees in your first year.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Three to five years of related experience in Information Technology.
  • Knowledge of software development life cycle principles, methods, and tools.
  • Ability to support applications, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical users.
  • Ability to learn to read code and work with programming and scripting languages, including SQL
  • Knowledge of interface construction.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, customer service, documentation, and training skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently with limited direction, and meet competing deadlines.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with administrative, clerical, and academic stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, Visio, Project, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to maintain positive and respectful working relationships, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and adhere to university policies and procedures.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience in a higher education administrative and/or academic computing environment.
  • Knowledge of flight systems and flight operations.
  • Experience with application support, enterprise reporting tools, SQL queries, data validation, requirements gathering, and system integrations.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodology related to application support and project management.
  • Experience with SplashBI or comparable reporting platforms.
  • Experience coordinating system upgrades, testing, application enhancements, and vendor relationships.

To submit your application for this opportunity, please visit the Embry-Riddle Career Site and search for requisition number R312313. Please attach all relevant materials to your application when you apply online. Complete submissions include:

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • Contact information for at least three professional references (please note that references may be contacted as part of the interview/screening process)

Current Embry-Riddle employees: Please apply directly through the ERAU Employee Hub Central application within Workday.

Embry-Riddle is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We strive to ensure that all faculty, staff, and students are treated fairly and provided equal opportunities for employment, advancement, compensation, training, and other benefits of employment. Embry-Riddle makes employment decisions — including hiring, promotions, compensation, and other terms of employment — based on individual merit, qualifications, and abilities. Embry-Riddle is strongly opposed to discrimination and harassment, and such behavior is prohibited by university policy. Embry-Riddle does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, veteran status, predisposing genetic characteristics, age, religion, or pregnancy status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law, in its employment, educational programs, admissions policies, financial aid, or other school-administered programs or activities. For further information, please visit our website.

Embry-Riddle does not accept unsolicited assistance from staffing or recruitment agencies. Agencies interested in partnering with the University should contact and should not contact hiring managers or other University employees directly.To preserve the integrity and authenticity of our hiring process, candidates are expected to participate without AI-assisted coaching, real-time response generation, or recording during interviews or assessments. Embry-Riddle does not use AI to automatically screen, rank, or select candidates.

About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

About the roleWe’re looking for experienced professionals to help improve how AI understands and performs real-world work. You’ll share your expertise, contribute to realistic scenarios, and review work for accuracy and quality.

Projects vary, but all require clear thinking, sound professional judgment, and attention to detail. No prior AI or machine learning experience is required.

What you’ll do

Depending on the project, you may:

  • Answer questions about the workflows, decisions, and challenges in your field.
  • Develop realistic scenarios and problems grounded in your professional experience.
  • Provide clear explanations, reference answers, and supporting examples.
  • Help define quality standards and assess work against them.
  • Test and refine content to reflect real-world complexity.
  • Review other contributors’ work for accuracy, clarity, and practical relevance.
  • Incorporate feedback promptly and flag gaps or unclear guidance.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, or substantial research experience in your field.
  • Strong professional judgment and the ability to spot subtle errors or gaps in reasoning.
  • Clear writing and the ability to explain complex ideas in straightforward terms.
  • Careful attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to question assumptions.
  • Comfort using spreadsheets, structured templates, and everyday digital tools.
  • Ability to work independently, respond to feedback, and meet deadlines.
  • Professional fluency in English.

We welcome experts across finance, law, medicine, engineering, science, mathematics, software, writing, and other professional fields.

Nice to have

  • Experience teaching, conducting research, publishing, or designing assessments.
  • Experience reviewing others’ work or providing structured feedback.
  • Previous involvement in AI training, evaluation, or similar projects.

Our standards

  • Original, human-authored work grounded in your expertise.
  • No copying or repackaging existing questions or published solutions.
  • Accurate, carefully checked contributions.
  • Quality over volume.

The Account Executive will play a crucial role in driving revenue growth for Splunk's Commercial accounts. You will establish a vision and plan for pipeline generation, consistently meet revenue targets, and directly impact customer experience. This role offers a dynamic environment where hardworking, driven sales professionals can contribute from day one while accessing opportunities for continuous learning and growth. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

  • Assist in reviewing and maintaining firm-wide policies and procedures including trading strategies, technology, investment guidelines, regulations, and/or daily workflows. Conduct annual testing of compliance procedures and documenting findings. Partner with AMFAM Corporate Legal and Compliance, Internal Controls/Audit, external investment managers, and other departments to develop, implement, and enforce policies and procedures for American Family Investments.
  • Code tests in Blackrock Aladdin to monitor investment guideline limits and restrictions and operational data validation checks. Maintain the Aladdin tests rule library to make sure it remains consistent with the most current guidelines, policies, and applicable securities laws.
  • Manage the compliance relationship with Blackrock to ensure timely responses to the firm’s compliance-related inquires and ensure that the latest compliance functionality is being utilized by American Family Investments. Oversee the full development lifecycle for all tokens and macros that are introduced and/or modified within Aladdin. Support the compliance daily workflow by troubleshooting and/or escalating any systems-related issues in a timely manner.
  • Assist in the administration of the compliance program, including oversight of the Code of Ethics and related compliance systems and processes. Responsibilities include maintaining and administering compliance software, onboarding and training new employees on the Code of Ethics, maintaining compliance records and systems, and reviewing and approving personal securities transactions, outside business activities, etc., in accordance with firm policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate audits and examinations and prepare attestations for internal/external auditors, regulatory bodies, and third parties/vendors, such as, SWIFT, state insurance regulators, federal regulatory agencies.
  • Prepare, review, and submit timely regulatory filings, including Form 13F, Schedule 13G, Form 13H, and Form N-PX, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with SEC filing deadlines.
  • Provide ad hoc support to American Family Investments management and other departments.
  • Provide thought leadership on industry best practices for compliance and educate the portfolio management team on new regulatory developments as they arise.

Specialized Knowledge and Skills Requirements

  • Experience with providing client-driven solutions, support, and service.
  • Deep understanding of securities trade lifecycle, trading practices, and workflows for various financial instruments and asset classes, specifically, Treasuries, Corporates, Municipals, ABS, CMBS, Equities, Convertibles, Commercial Real Estate Loans, Private Equity, and/or Derivatives.
  • Background in Investment Advisers Act of 1940, Investment Company Act of 1940, SEC reporting, ERISA, State Insurance Regulations, AML, KYC, OFAC sanction monitoring, and/or designing/executing compliance policies and procedures.
  • Familiarity with other operational groups such as investment accounting and investment management operations.
  • Understanding of technology, capital market, and accounting data flows, and relational databases.
  • Prior securities market data experience and/or knowledge a plus (i.e. Bloomberg, Refinitive, NRSRO, any benchmark providers, etc.).
  • Experience with using buy-side compliance software systems, such as Blackrock Aladdin, Bloomberg AIM, Orion Compliance, StarCompliance, MyComplianceOffice, etc.
  • Advanced degree(s) in Business Management, Finance, or Economics preferred.
  • Professional designation/certification (i.e. IACCP, CFA, CSCP, or CAMS) a plus.

Additional Information

  • To ensure a strong start, all employees participate in our New Employee Orientation during their first week.  This experience is held in person at our Madison, WI Headquarters or one of our AmFam core locations to help you connect with our mission, meet key team members and build relationships that support your growth.  At times, sessions may be delivered virtually based on scheduling and availability.

  • Offer to selected candidate is contingent on signing a non-disclosure agreement for proprietary information, trade secrets, and inventions

In this primarily home-based role, on occasion you may be asked to travel to an office location for in person engagement activities such as team meetings, trainings, and culture events.


We provide benefits that support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. You will have access to comprehensive medical, dental, vision and wellbeing benefits that enable you to take care of your health. We also offer a competitive 401(k) contribution, a pension plan, an annual incentive, 9 paid holidays and a paid time off program (23 days accrued annually for full-time employees). ABOUT US

Rythm is the fastest-growing lab in America. We redefined at-home testing with the world’s easiest blood test and created a culture around monthly lab testing from home. We’ve processed millions of tests across all 50 states, and we do everything in-house, from sample testing and logistics to code, marketing, and design. That vertical integration gives us the speed, control, and creativity to shape the future of health and wellness.

THE ROLE

As a Staff Mobile Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping the mobile experience at the center of Rythm's personalized health platform.

This is a highly impactful opportunity for an experienced, hands-on engineer who thrives in early-stage environments and wants to own meaningful work. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and design to solve complex problems and turn evolving ideas into mobile experiences that feel simple and intuitive. This is a critical position to our business in order to drive the next phase of Rythm's growth.

We are looking for someone who can set technical direction while remaining close to the code, move comfortably through ambiguity, and bring strong judgment to both product and engineering decisions. You'll have significant ownership over our mobile architecture, development practices, and the quality of the experiences we deliver to our Rythm customers each and every day.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own Rythm’s mobile apps from architecture and development through launch and ongoing improvement.
  • Build reliable, intuitive, and high-quality mobile experiences that make complex health information significantly easier for our customers to understand and use.
  • Partner closely with product and design to translate evolving requirements into thoughtful technical solutions.
  • Make practical technical decisions that balance speed, scalability, long-term maintenance, and the member experience.
  • Help define how we build mobile products, including our approach to testing, releases, performance, security, and monitoring.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across the mobile stack and the services that support it.
  • Collaborate with backend and infrastructure engineers to design dependable APIs, data flows, and integrations.
  • Provide technical leadership through strong execution, clear communication, and high-quality code reviews.
  • Identify risks, challenge assumptions, and help the team make better technical and product decisions.
  • Use modern development tools, including AI-assisted workflows, to increase speed and quality without lowering the engineering bar.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • You’ve built and shipped mobile apps used by real customers and have owned major architectural and technical decisions.
  • You’ve led complex projects from the initial idea through launch and continued improvement.
  • Proven experience with native iOS, native Android, or cross-platform mobile development.
  • A deep understanding of what it takes to build a mobile app that is reliable, fast, testable, and easy to maintain.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with APIs, authentication systems, analytics, notifications, and third-party services.
  • An ability to think beyond the code and make practical decisions based on what’s best for the product and the people using it.
  • Somebody who absolutely thrives in a fast-moving, highly ambiguous environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative working style across engineering, product, marketing and design.
  • A hands-on mindset; you enjoy leading through building and do not want to move away from the technical work.
  • Somebody who takes full ownership, has little to no ego, and works well without a lot of structure.
  • Experience in healthcare, consumer health, direct-to-consumer and sensitive-data environments preferred.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

Rythm Health offers a benefits package which includes:

  • A highly competitive base salary.
  • Meaningful equity aligned with the scope and impact of your role.
  • A monthly Rythm membership with full access to at-home blood testing and personalized health insights.
  • High ownership and visibility from day one, with the ability to make a meaningful impact.
  • The chance to help shape the future of personalized health and preventative care.
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment.
  • A generous paid time off policy.
  • 401(k).
  • Multiple healthcare plan options, with select plans fully covered by Rythm.
  • A small, collaborative, mission-driven team that moves quickly and values great ideas regardless of title.
