DEPARTMENT OF FORESTRY AND FIRE MANAGEMENT

In partnership with local, county, state, and federal agencies, the Arizona Department of Forestry and Fire Management (DFFM) protects Arizona’s people by: providing coordination and resource response for the suppression and management of wildland fire; delivering education to aid in wildland fire prevention; providing integrated management strategies, technical assistance and information through various Department programs; collaborating in forest restoration projects; and ensuring fire and life safety through permitting, plan reviews and building inspections.

Forest Legacy Program Manager

Job Location:

Address:1110 W Washington St, Ste 500 Phoenix, AZ 85007 or

700 E Butler Ave, Flagstaff, AZ 86001 or

1133 West Road 3 North Chino Valley AZ 86323 or

1100 N Beeline Highway Payson AZ 85541 or

316 W. White Mountain Blvd., Unit A Lakeside AZ 85929

Posting Details:

Salary: $32.4840-$33.6539 Hourly

Grade: 22

Closing Date: Open Until Filled

Job Summary:

The Forest Legacy Program Manager is responsible for administering all aspects of the Department of Forestry and Fire Management's (DFFM) Forest Legacy and Community Forest Legacy (CFLP) Programs. This position develops and implements strategies, plans and budgets, recruits projects for submission to available national Request for Project Proposals, conducts stakeholder engagement and outreach, coordinates due diligence and land acquisitions, and monitors and reports on all funded projects.

This position is 100% grant-funded; funding is reviewed annually.

This position offers the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:
  • Work with partners to administer the Forest Legacy Program (FLP) and Community Forest Legacy Program (CFLP). Liaise, build and maintain relationships with the US Forest Service, Local and Regional governments, non-governmental organizations, private landowners, contractors and other partners and stakeholders in FLP and CFLP initiatives.
  • Oversee grant and budget administration for all aspects of the FLP and CFLP. Compile and review applications; draft narratives and submit comprehensive funding proposals for federal consideration; manage multi-million dollar budgets, ensuring proper allocation of federal capital and partner match; track metrics and compile annual accomplishment reports for federal partners and state leadership.
  • Navigate terms for complex land acquisitions with private landowners. Draft and review legally binding conservation easement documents. Coordinate due diligence processes, including property appraisals, mineral evaluations, and baseline documentation reports. Oversee annual monitoring of all existing FLP-funded conservation properties to ensure easement compliance.
  • Develop, manage, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive Forest Legacy and Community Forestry Program Strategic Plan. Review, revise, and maintain the Assessment of Need Report delivered with the 10-year USFS Forest Action Plan. Participate in annual and 5-year program reviews, maintain state program guidance document for FLP and CFLP. Implement program priorities, funding, and policies and maintain program records.
  • Administer FLP and CFLP cost-share project awards and other related programs, including awards and master agreements. Manage pass through awards, projects, contracts, and annual program budgets for staff and special projects. Engage and oversee providers, manage contracts for services (legal, survey, appraisal, minerals determination, stewardship plans, etc.). Track project status using the USFS data management systems.Conduct site visits.
  • With the Stewardship Program Manager, co-coordinate and provide oversight to the Forest Stewardship Statewide Advisory Committee and participate on statewide and national FLP advisory boards.
  • Other duties as assigned as related to the position.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge of:

  • State and Federal Forest Legacy Program and Community Forest Legacy Program policies and protocols., and grant regulations (Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200).
  • Basic forestry measurements, stewardship planning, and best practices.
  • Conservation easements, property titles, boundary surveys, due diligence and land appraisal standards.
  • Strategic Planning and Program Evaluation.

Skills in:

  • Legal and process document review.
  • Communication, including writing, editing, talking, listening, educating, and public speaking.
  • Project and budget management and use of project management tools and databases. Organizing internal and external teams to complete work by stated deadlines.
  • Legal document review.
  • Organization of ideas and documents.
  • Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and spatial analysis.
  • Creating and maintaining interpersonal relationships.
  • Research and analytical skills.

Ability to:

  • Review and understand complex legal and process documents.
  • Plan work independently, adhere to schedules and set and meet deadlines.
  • Envision and execute strategies.
  • Build diverse partnerships, recruit and motivate partners to submit project elements on a deadline.
  • Translate complex environmental metrics, legal property terms, and federal rules to non-technical private landowners.
  • Tactfully interact with regulatory authorities and other governmental agencies and private land owners.
  • Drive on state business with possible overnight stays.
  • Some out of state travel.
Selective Preference(s):

The ideal candidate for this position will have:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Forestry, Natural Resource Management, Conservation, or related field.
  • Experience with land acquisitions and conservation easements.
  • Three years work experience in a relevant profession, vocation, or activity.
Pre-Employment Requirements:
  • A valid Arizona Driver's License.

Any employee operating a motor vehicle on State business must possess and retain a current, valid class-appropriate driver’s license, complete all required training, and successfully pass all necessary driver’s license record checks. The license must be current, unexpired, and neither revoked nor suspended. Employees who drive on state business are subject to driver’s license record checks, must maintain acceptable driving records, and must complete all required driver training. An employee who operates a personally owned vehicle on state business shall maintain the statutorily required liability insurance (see Arizona Administrative Code (A.A.C.) R2-10-207.11).

All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify).

Benefits:

The State of Arizona provides an excellent comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Affordable medical, dental, life, and short-term disability insurance plans
  • Top-ranked retirement and long-term disability plans
  • 10 paid holidays per year
  • Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program, learn more at hr.az.gov/family-leave-expansion).
  • Vacation time accrued at 4.00 hours bi-weekly for the first 3 years
  • Sick time accrued at 3.70 hours bi-weekly
  • Deferred compensation plan
  • Wellness plans
  • Tuition reimbursement eligible after one year of employment

Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our benefits page

Retirement:
  • Positions in this classification participate in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS)
  • Participation is a mandatory condition of employment for all employees who meet the eligibility and membership criteria as defined in statute.
  • Enrollment eligibility will become effective after 27 weeks of employment.
  • The current contribution rate is 11.98%

raw.description:
AlphaGov is seeking an Impact Fee & Housing Nexus Study Consultant to prepare technical analyses and fee recommendations for a local government engagement. You will evaluate how new development affects public infrastructure and housing demand, document the basis for proposed fees, and support the client through review and adoption.

This engagement requires direct experience developing defensible studies that connect development impacts, documented needs, and proposed fees under applicable state requirements.

What you’ll do

  • Review existing fee programs, development forecasts, capital improvement plans, housing data, and relevant prior studies.
  • Coordinate with planning, finance, public works, housing staff, and legal counsel to establish study assumptions and requirements.
  • Analyze infrastructure needs attributable to new development and distinguish them from existing deficiencies.
  • Prepare housing nexus analyses connecting the development types under study to associated housing demand.
  • Develop transparent calculation models, allocation methods, and proposed fee schedules with supporting documentation.
  • Evaluate applicable credits, offsets, and alternative funding sources to avoid double counting.
  • Prepare draft and final reports explaining the methodology, findings, fee recommendations, and implementation options.
  • Present findings to staff, stakeholders, and governing bodies, and address technical questions during review and adoption.

Requirements

  • Direct experience preparing development impact fee studies, housing nexus studies, or both for local governments.
  • Experience applying the relevant state’s requirements to study methodology and documentation.
  • Strong quantitative skills in development forecasting, infrastructure cost allocation, housing analysis, and fee modeling.
  • Ability to distinguish the maximum fee supported by the analysis from the fee a jurisdiction may choose to adopt.
  • Experience working with municipal staff and legal counsel to address technical review comments.
  • Clear technical writing and public presentation skills.

Experience supporting fee adoption and subsequent updates is preferred.

Benefits

Submit your résumé and a brief summary of comparable studies. Identify the jurisdictions and states, study types, your responsibilities, and whether the studies supported adopted fee programs.

The Technical Operations Associate II (L1) serves as the single point of contact for incidents and service requests, and performs first-line monitoring of production jobs, files, and batch workflows across healthcare systems. The role is responsible for ticket management, initial triage, status and file monitoring, and SLA adherence, ensuring every issue is captured, categorized, routed, and tracked to closure without gaps or delays. The L1 associate detects and reports job failures, delays, and missing files, escalating anything that requires reconciliation, reprocessing, data correction, or job-level investigation to L2.

As a Technical Operations Associate II (L1), you will be accountable for the following:

  • Monitor the ITSM tool continuously for new incidents and service requests
  • Acknowledge all tickets within agreed SLA windows and confirm receipt with the requester
  • Classify and prioritize tickets based on impact, urgency, and SLA
  • Validate ticket completeness and obtain additional information when needed
  • Perform initial categorization and assign tickets to the appropriate support group per the defined assignment matrix
  • Ensure all required information is captured before routing to avoid reassignments
  • Escalate tickets to L2 or the relevant resolver group based on priority, impact, or SLA breach risk per the escalation process
  • Perform monitoring of scheduled batch jobs using monitoring tools, dashboards, and job trackers, per the defined runbook and processing calendar
  • Track job starts, in-progress status, and completion using monitoring tools, application logs, and defined checkpoints
  • Monitor inbound and outbound file transfers to confirm expected files arrive and are dispatched on schedule

  • Maintain real-time job monitoring trackers for all critical workflows

raw.description:
Ready to guide the CMC path for one of the first gene therapies built for a prevalent, age-related disease, from CDMO kickoff to first-in-human?

The Journey and Destination:

Gordian is a therapeutics company whose mission is to cure age-related disease. Our Mosaic Screening platform pools interventions in living animals, giving causal validation for hundreds of targets at once. You can read more on ourwebsite and in ourpreprint.

The engine is working. We have results across six disease areas and have mappednearly as many targets as the field reported in 20 years. Anovel osteoarthritis candidate is in IND-enabling studies, and we've started an obesitydrug-discovery collaboration with Pfizer. Now we're taking our first AAV program toward the clinic, and what we do here will set the precedent for gene therapies in prevalent disease.

The Project

We're looking for an AAV CMC expert to help take our first gene therapy program to first-in-human, on an aggressive timeline. You'll size up where our CMC stands, shape our strategy with our external CDMO, and run the regular working meetings that keep the CDMO moving fast and delivering the right quality and quantity of material, on time. You bring the expertise and the recommendations; Gordian makes the final program calls.

This is a hands-on engagement, not a name on a slide. You'll set the agenda for CDMO meetings, bring sharp recommendations on process, analytics, and release, turn every meeting into clear next steps, and follow up until the CDMO delivers, pushing timelines when they need pushing. How you get there is up to you.

What You'll Deliver:

In the first month, you'll run a thorough CMC gap analysis against our target product profile and hand us a prioritized plan for closing any gaps you find. You'll also bring your technical eye to our CDMO master services agreement and the initial process development and manufacturing plan.

Through months 1–6, you'll run the CDMO working meetings, turn each one into written next steps with owners and due dates, and chase deliverables to the finish line. You'll guide upstream, downstream, and analytical development, including a phase-appropriate potency assay strategy, and draft Module 3 for our pre-IND package so we get the most out of our FDA interaction.

By six months, the CDMO's non-GMP engineering run will have delivered material for our GLP-tox study, and you'll have drafted Module 3 content for our pre-IND and IND submissions. You'll prepare the CMC briefing and walk into FDA meetings as our CMC expert, ready to take the agency's questions.

And You

You're an independent CMC consultant who has done this before and wants to do it again on something first-of-its-kind. You bring the judgment of a seasoned CMC pro, make well-supported recommendations, and are comfortable holding a CDMO accountable to timelines and quality. When a manufacturing question needs an answer, you go back to the science to settle it.

You must have:

  • Taken an AAV gene therapy through CMC to a first-in-human Phase 1 trial
  • Experience with a triple-transfection HEK293 suspension process
  • Managed external vendors with strength in project management, conflict resolution, and holding timelines.
  • Written or substantially contributed to Module 3 of a pre-IND and IND application

Bonus points if you have:

  • Directly managed CDMOs for AAV manufacturing
  • Taken multiple products through successful INDs and GMP batches
  • Experience with analytical development in a GLP/GMP setting
  • Broad fluency across CMC: process development, analytical development, drug substance, drug product, and supply chain
  • Taking an AAV into later-phase trials or commercialization
  • Designing large-animal IND-enabling or toxicology studies
  • Sharp regulatory judgment

The Details:

  • Independent consulting. You'll work as an independent contractor under a consulting agreement, with the specifics set out in a Statement of Work once we've found the right fit. You're free to keep working with your other clients barring any conflict of interest.
  • Timing. A project of roughly six months, kicking off in December 2026.
  • Flexible hours. Roughly 20–40 hours a week depending on the phase, on your own schedule around CDMO meetings and milestones.
  • Remote, with occasional trips to Gordian HQ to present major deliverables and to the CDMO as manufacturing ramps up. Travel expenses are covered.

Application Due Date: 10/30 and will be evaluated on a rolling basis

If you want to guide a first-of-its-kind gene therapy to the clinic, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Experience using customer or user research methods such as interviews, surveys, contextual inquiry, research synthesis, affinity mapping, personas, Jobs-to-be-Done, concept testing, usability testing, heuristic evaluation, or service blueprinting.

  • Experience creating or executing test scenarios and using usability, quality, behavioral, or business results to support measurable customer and operational improvements.

raw.title: Security Operations Lead
raw.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
raw.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

As Security Operations Lead, you'll lead our SecOps squad and own how Sword detects, investigates, and responds to threats. You'll help structure how this function operates — setting the direction on SIEM architecture, detection engineering, and incident response — and use automation and AI to scale a focused team across a fast-growing, multi-continent footprint. You'll be a core voice in our security strategy, and the systems, processes, and culture you build will set the bar for how Sword protects 700,000+ members.

To get to know more about our Tech Stack, check here.

What you’ll be doing

  • Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Sword’s Security Operations Center. Setting the technical direction — architecting the SIEM, engineering detection logic, executing incident response, and building the technical roadmap to scale our defenses as the company grows.

  • Own the SIEM end-to-end (architecture, data sources, normalization, retention, cost, and tuning) and evolve detection-as-code content aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and Sword’s threat model.

  • Lead the SOC/CSIRT team technically — mentoring detection and response engineers, raising the bar on investigations, running on-call and escalation models, and acting as commander for major incidents.

  • Set the strategy and technical direction for Sword’s Security Operations Center — defining the operating model, SIEM and detection architecture, incident response capability, and the roadmap to scale them as the company grows.

  • Drive an AI- and automation-first transformation of security operations: design SOAR playbooks, agentic and LLM-assisted triage workflows, and ML-driven detection to reduce MTTD/MTTR, expand coverage, and let a lean team operate at enterprise scale.

  • Lead high-severity incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, partnering with engineering, IT, legal, and executive stakeholders during critical events.

  • Run the threat intelligence and threat hunting programs, converting emerging TTPs into new detections, proactive hardening, and informed risk decisions.

  • Advanced Incident Response & Threat Hunting: Lead end-to-end incident investigations in Google SecOps, leveraging complex telemetry correlation to proactively hunt for threats, contain active incidents, and drive root-cause remediation.

  • Define and report on SOC performance — MTTD, MTTR, coverage, automation rate, false-positive rate, on-call health — and use those metrics to drive measurable, continuous improvement.

  • Influence security architecture and engineering decisions across the company, ensuring detection, response, and recovery are built into new products, platforms, and infrastructure from day one.

  • Detection & Automation Leadership: Architect, refine, and maintain custom YARA-L detection rules and SOAR playbooks in Google SecOps to automate triage, alert enrichment, and initial incident response.

What you need to have

  • Required: Public Trust Clearance - Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US public trust clearance.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 7+ years experience in Security Operations

  • Proven experience scaling a SOC through automation and AI — SOAR, hyperautomation, LLM-assisted triage, agentic workflows, or ML-driven detection — with measurable impact on MTTR, coverage, or analyst leverage.

  • Hands-on experience structuring a SOC, either building one from the ground up or maturing one through significant transformation — SIEM selection, implementation or migration, detection engineering practice, runbook libraries, on-call rotations, and operating metrics.

  • Deep SIEM expertise (Splunk, Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, Elastic, or similar) — ingestion architecture, detection-as-code, query optimization, and coverage-versus-cost tradeoffs.

    • Highly preferred: Google SecOps/Chronicle

  • Prior experience as the technical lead of a SOC or CSIRT team — owning the full incident response lifecycle, mentoring analysts and engineers, and acting as on-call/incident commander during major incidents.

  • Strong incident response track record — leading high-severity investigations, root cause analysis, digital forensics, and post-incident reviews that produced durable improvements.

  • Solid experience in cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP), with strong understanding of cloud-native threats and controls.

  • Strong scripting and development skills (Python, Go, Bash, or similar) for building automation, integrations, and internal tooling.

  • Working knowledge of EDR/XDR, identity, and network detection telemetry, and how to combine signals into high-fidelity detections.

  • Fluency with security frameworks and standards (NIST 800-61, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001) and the judgment to apply them pragmatically.

  • Background in threat modeling, adversary emulation, and risk-based alert tuning.

  • Excellent communicator — able to brief executives during a Sev1, write a clear post-mortem, and translate technical risk into business language for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional efforts in high-pressure situations and fostering collaboration across InfoSec, IT, and engineering.

  • Forensics experience, investigating incidents and preserving digital evidence.

Public Trust Clearance

Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US public trust clearance.
Please note that US citizenship is required to obtain and maintain a government security clearance.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
$133,978—$210,537 USD
Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.

Job Title: Head of Client Success

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Head of Client Success will drive enterprise retention through product adoption and drive long-term customer value creation the client portfolios. If you're ready to lead transformational client success initiatives and make a lasting impact on our business and our clients, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

    • Develop and execute customer success strategy aligned with company growth objectives, customer business outcomes, retention, and long-term customer value creation
    • Own customer retention and supporting sales in revenue expansion across the customer portfolio, renewals, net revenue retention, cross-sell, upsell, and overall account growth
    • Lead strategic account planning and governance in partnership with Sales, establishing account plans, executive engagement models, and processes to identify and capture growth opportunities
    • Drive customer adoption and time-to-value by developing success plans that accelerate implementation, product utilization, business impact, and realization of customer ROI
    • Establish customer health frameworks and performance metrics to measure adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, renewal risk, retention, expansion, and overall portfolio performance
    • Use data, analytics, and experimentation to identify opportunities, evaluate program effectiveness, optimize customer engagement, and continuously improve customer success strategies
    • Lead executive customer relationships by serving as a trusted advisor, executive sponsor, and escalation point for strategic accounts and complex customer challenges
    • Partner cross-functionally with Sales and Product to align customer priorities with product strategy, commercial objectives, and service delivery
    • Translate customer insights into business strategy by identifying emerging customer needs, market trends, adoption barriers, and opportunities for product innovation and go-to-market improvement
    • Design scalable customer success operating models that balance high-touch strategic engagement with digital, programmatic, and self-service approaches to improve efficiency and customer lifetime value
    • Establish operational rigor and accountability through standardized processes, success methodologies, portfolio reviews, forecasting, performance dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives
    • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing organization by recruiting, coaching, retaining, and developing talent; establishing clear performance expectations; and building leadership succession
    • Champion AI adoption and digital transformation across the customer success organization, identifying opportunities to automate administrative work, improve decision-making, and enable teams to focus on strategic customer engagement
    • Communicate business performance and strategic priorities to executive leadership, presenting customer insights, retention and growth results, operational performance, risks, and recommendations
    • Represent the company as a strategic partner and industry thought leader through executive engagements, customer forums, and external industry relationships

Requirements

    • 15+ years of progressive experience in client services, account management, customer success, or related client-facing leadership roles, with a track record of managing complex client relationships and driving business growth
    • 7+ years of experience leading client services, account management, or customer-facing teams, including developing talent, scaling operations, and delivering measurable client and business outcomes
    • Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise accounts and building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior stakeholders
    • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical technology, or other regulated industries
    • Proven track record of driving customer adoption across the product portfolio
    • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including account growth strategy, revenue forecasting, customer lifetime value, and return on investment
    • Experience building and implementing scalable Customer Success strategies, operating models, processes, and governance frameworks
    • Demonstrated ability to use customer data, analytics, and performance metrics to assess customer health, identify risks, and drive business outcomes
    • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Marketing to achieve customer and company objectives
    • Proven ability to lead organizational change, improve operational effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
    • Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills
    • Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing teams while establishing a culture of accountability and continuous learning
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

Nice to Have

    • Proven track record of driving customer retention, renewals, revenue expansion, and net revenue retention across enterprise customer portfolios
    • Experience building and scaling digital, tech-touch, or programmatic Customer Success models that serve large customer populations efficiently
    • Experience implementing AI-powered customer engagement, agentic workflows, and automation to improve customer outcomes and team productivity
    • Experience designing customer lifecycle programs, including digital onboarding, adoption campaigns, lifecycle communications, and self-service experiences
    • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, leading indicators, and data-driven optimization of customer engagement programs
    • Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud software, CRM, data platforms, or other technology-enabled business solutions
    • Experience translating customer insights and market trends into product strategy, roadmap priorities, and go-to-market initiatives
    • Experience developing customer health scoring, predictive retention models, adoption metrics, and portfolio performance dashboards
    • Experience managing global or geographically distributed customer success teams and enterprise customer portfolios
    • Experience establishing executive customer advisory programs, strategic partnerships, and industry thought leadership
    • Master's degree in business, technology, or a related discipline

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $200,000 - $270,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Tracking e implementação

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Design, deliver, and administer specialized training in life, annuity, and health underwriting covering analysis techniques, risk assessment, modeling, and tools and technology used to interpret and apply criteria for accurate risk assessments. Implement career development and engagement programs to improve the employee experience.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Apply best practices in curriculum design and delivery to department staff and stakeholders in alignment with industry and company requirements.
  • Develop clear and measurable learning criteria for different levels of underwriting knowledge and technical expertise.
  • Keep current on regulatory rules, product offerings, and technology advances. Share insights through group and individual training.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of training/identify gaps and collaborate with management on ways to enhance the learning experience.
  • Assess team needs to identify and create opportunities for career development and employee engagement.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects/programs requiring collaboration with Underwriting.

Qualifications

  • Six years of underwriting experience in the insurance/financial services industry
  • Skilled in underwriting training or project/process management in a corporate environment
  • Outstanding written and oral communication and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

  

Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

raw.description:
Revenue, Technical Accounting & Policy Senior Manager


POSITION OVERVIEW

MRI Software is seeking a Revenue, Technical Accounting & Policy Senior Manager to lead a newly established global team responsible for revenue recognition, technical accounting and accounting policy. The role will provide authoritative accounting guidance, establish and maintain group-wide accounting policies, govern significant revenue accounting judgements and support complex commercial arrangements, financial reporting and the overall control environment.


ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES


Revenue recognition governance:

  • Lead the accounting review of material, unusual and non-standard customer arrangements to ensure appropriate revenue recognition outcomes.
  • Own and maintain the revenue recognition framework across all revenue types (eg. SaaS, subscription, term licence, perpetual licence, maintenance, implementation, professional services, usage-based and partner arrangements).
  • Review and challenge the conclusions of the revenue accounting team, ensuring revenue is recognised appropriately and that process, system or control gaps are identified and remediated in partnership with the Finance Transformation team.
  • Approve revenue accounting adjustments arising from contract reviews, accounting assessments or control activities.
  • Partner with Sales and Legal teams to ensure the optimal revenue outcome from in-flight contracts.

Technical accounting and policy:

  • Own the group accounting policy manual and ensure policies remain current, practical and consistently applied across regions.
  • Research complex accounting matters and provide clear and practical guidance to stakeholders across the business.
  • Act as the accounting subject matter expert for significant accounting judgements impacting statutory and group reporting.
  • Prepare and review audit-ready technical accounting papers that clearly articulate the relevant facts, accounting guidance, analysis, judgements and conclusions.
  • Monitor new accounting standards and regulatory developments; assess impact and lead on adoption.

Other:

  • Partner with the Audit, Controls & Reporting Manager to:

odesign and maintain key controls.

osupport the successful delivery of statutory and group audits.

  • Partner with Legal, Commercial and Corporate Development teams to provide accounting guidance on significant customer arrangements, strategic transactions and acquisitions.
  • Develop the capability of the wider finance organisation through training, guidance and coaching.
  • Drive simplification, standardisation and automation while preserving appropriate review and control.

REQUIREMENTS


Minimum:


•CPA professional qualification.

  • 8+ years of relevant accounting experience, incl. substantial post-qualification experience.
  • Demonstrable experience applying ASC 606 and/or IFRS15 to software, SaaS or other recurring-revenue contracts, including complex and non-standard arrangements.
  • Proven ability to research accounting guidance and produce high-quality technical papers that withstand senior management and external audit review.
  • A problem solver, with the ability to identify, understand, and resolve technical and procedural challenges.
  • Experience leading significant workstreams and reviewing or managing the work of others.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to explain technical conclusions clearly.
  • Strong Excel and financial systems capability, with experience extracting, reconciling and analysing large or complex datasets.

Desirable:


  • Experience in a multinational software or SaaS group.
  • Demonstrable experience of using AI to create more efficient and robust review processes.
  • Knowledge of both IFRS and US GAAP, and exposure to local GAAP or statutory reporting.
  • Experience of M&A accounting, purchase price allocation and acquired contract balances.

WHY JOIN US

This is a unique opportunity to lead MRI Software's Revenue, Technical Accounting & Policy team, partnering with the wider finance organization to support a growing global business. The Revenue, Technical Accounting & Policy Senior Manager will play a key role in enhancing MRI Software’s revenue control activities and shaping accounting policy.


About Us

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you! 

Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

At MRI, one of our core values is to strive to amaze.  From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?  

We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!  

MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.

We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!

This is a remote position.

Are you looking to grow your skills in Tech PR? Are you interested in a clear career path toward excellence?

At Spark PR we work with some of the brightest brands in the world (and those you’ll be hearing about soon) to support customer acquisition and branding strategies and their tactical execution. We are looking for driven individuals to join our team and help Spark grow!

Why Work At Spark?

  • Remote Work Flexibility
  • State of the Art Apple Computers and Remote Workplace setup!
  • Competitive Trimester Bonus Program
  • Flexible Paid Vacation Policy (We respect your need to unplug!)
  • Spark PR covers 95-100% of health, dental, and vision for our employees
  • You can also count on a company-managed 401K, Flexible Spending Accounts, and monthly cell phone subsidy.

Position Summary:

Senior Account Executives are the hub of all activity on their accounts. They have day-to-day responsibility for keeping things running smoothly, ensuring deadlines are met and overseeing junior team members.

  • Visibility into every program on several tech accounts, including ownership and deliverables
  • Solid media relations skills and the ability to deliver high-visibility wins for your clients – activities that include pitching and securing media opportunities, writing (media pitches, press releases and speaker submissions) as well as coordinating tours and campaigns
  • Strong strategic skills and ability to interact effectively with client executives, consistently demonstrating understanding of client business, market and competitive situation
  • Knowledge of major industry trends affecting clients, the events driving news cycles and ability to proactively exploit them on behalf of clients
  • Ability to effectively coordinate and work both up and down within teams
  • Contribute to new business pitches through research, brainstorming and program creation
  • Effectively present at new business meetings and pitches
  • Actively manage productivity and find ways to make tangible agency contributions
  • Track non-billable and client billable time daily

Pre-Requisites

  • 3+ years of professional experience in public relations or communications-related field
  • Bachelor’s degree in public relations, English or communications-related field
  • Solid relationships with press, and a proven track record of great coverage
  • Ability to multi-task and manage projects from start to finish
  • Creative and a self-starter
  • Strong writing skills – able to develop great pitches, press releases, PR plans, etc., and be able to deliver client ready material

About Spark

From startups to Fortune 20 members, Spark specializes in helping technology-focused and innovation-minded companies transform their brands by bringing powerful narratives to life through public relations and integrated marketing programs.

The agency’s full suite of services includes content and social development, programmatic distribution and other forms of paid media, and data-driven insights to inform strategic planning and measure go-to-market plans. Spark also provides comprehensive strategic communications & marketing services for blockchain and cryptocurrency leaders. From guiding successful token sales to growing companies post-ICO, Spark has emerged as the preferred partner for these highly specialized services across the globe.

Spark’s clients are some of the world’s most innovative startups and industry leaders. Please review our website and peruse the variety of brands we have worked with over the years.

Ranked on the 2021 Forbes Best PR Agencies list, Spark has also been honored by Business Intelligence Group as a Best Place to Work. Previous awards include Bulldog Reporter’s Awards for Best New Product Launch and Best General Business Campaign as well as SABRE Awards for Software and Services. Spark was also honored as the Public Relations Agency of the Year by PR World in 2017.

Spark was founded by Donna (Sokolsky) Burke and Christine Hempel in 1999 at the height of the Internet explosion in Silicon Valley. Fresh off their corporate careers at Netscape where they helped launch the first browser that gave millions access to the Internet, Donna and Christine were well equipped to create a new-economy communications agency. Imagine getting to learn from industry experts that have been involved in launching so many world-changing technologies!

We are excited to explore new opportunities with you!

Spark Public Relations is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. Spark PR does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

Overview

PLEASE NOTE: No corp-to-corp candidates will be accepted.

  • Tier One Technologies has an immediate need for a Principal Enterprise Security Architect for our US Government client.
  • This remote contract-to-hire position can be originated in Falls Church, VA, Morrisville, NC or Eagan, MN.
  • SELECTED CANDIDATES WITHOUT REQUIRED CLEARANCE WILL BE SUBJECT TO A FEDERAL GOVERNMENT BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION TO RECEIVE IT.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the strategic and technical bridge between Security Operations, CISO leadership, and Enterprise Infrastructure teams.
  • Operate within the Corporate Information Security Office (CISO), collaborating directly with internal and external stakeholders to align corporate initiatives with robust cybersecurity strategies.
  • Maintain and continuously enhance the enterprise security posture throughout ongoing infrastructure modernization and evolution toward the target architectural state.
  • Identify structural security gaps across a hybrid environment encompassing multiple physical data centers and multi-cloud platforms and engineer resilient solutions to mitigate risks using security intelligence (SI) and large language models (LLMs).
  • Serve as the primary security architecture advisor to CISO Engineering (CISO ENG), translating complex technical risks and structural vulnerabilities into clear, measurable business-risk metrics.
  • Lead collaborative architecture design, threat modeling, and remediation sessions involving the CISO office, Network Engineering, Endpoint Management, and external vendors and partners.
  • Develop and maintain the Enterprise Security Architecture roadmap, ensuring that security technology investments align with CISO objectives and business requirements across edge and network defense, cloud security, transport security, endpoint protection, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Leverage technical expertise and vendor solutions to advance security intelligence automation across the enterprise.
  • Establish, implement, and enforce infrastructure security governance frameworks, standards, and policies.
  • Manage and advise on the planning and operational execution of all CISO Engineering Security Edge workstreams.
  • Conduct rigorous, proactive architectural reviews of the global hybrid infrastructure to identify structural weaknesses, supported by continuous monitoring and ongoing security assessments.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering field preferred. BS degree from an accredited College/University in the applicable field of services is required, or 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a college degree.
  • 15+ years of experience with Edge and Perimeter Protection solutions and designs - IDS/IPS, WAF/WAAP, SDWAN remote security.
  • 15+ years of experience with hands-on architectural experience across the entire technical scope: PKI, NDR, NGFW, WAAP, EDR/XDR, and SIEM), IDS/IPS, DNS Protection, Proxy, Webproxy, PAC, Loadbalancer, IP routing, Data Center designs.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity and infrastructure, with 5+ years in a dedicated architecture role directly influencing architectural decisions and priority.
  • Expert knowledge of SASE/SSE Convergence – SDWAN, (CASB), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).
  • Strong experience with Network service security and infrastructure – DNS security, PKI and CAOps, Proxy.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust tenets and principles, and practical application of the principles.
  • In-depth understanding of Security Framework Alignment: Map all infrastructure patterns to prevailing industry standards and best practices, specifically NIST CSF / SP 800-53 and the CIS Critical Security Controls.
  • In-depth understanding of hybrid large scale enterprise: Strong history of assessing and securing complex enterprise environments spanning multiple physical data centers and comprehensive multi-cloud environments from various cloud service providers. (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience with development and application of governance policy and standards in application of security tools, and Security Governance process/workstream management, while working to leverage SI to automate processes.
  • Certifications Required: CCIE and CISSP.Desired Training: Microsoft Azure, GCP, AWS Fundamentals/Associate, Splunk, x-AI Fundamentals.
  • Experience with security Incident response activities.
  • Understanding AI application development methodology.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Must be a US Citizen or Permanent US Resident (Green Card Holder).
  • Must be able to obtain Public Trust Clearance.
  • Be able to pass a drug screening, criminal history, and credit checks.
  • Must have lived in the United States for the past 5 years.
  • Cannot have more than 6 months travel outside the United States within the last 5 years. Military Service excluded. (Exception does not include military family members.)

raw.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Headspace reaches millions of members through 1,500+ employer and health plan clients. As CRM Lead, you'll set the B2B2C lifecycle strategy with the leadership and personally deliver it for a focused portfolio of utilization-based and strategic accounts, where CRM performance directly affects contract outcomes. You'll also build the foundation that lets the rest of the book run at scale, and you'll lead and develop the CRM Manager.

This is a true player-coach role. Expect to spend roughly half your time building in Braze and the rest on strategy, architecture, experimentation, and coaching.

What you’ll be doing

  • Define the B2B2C CRM strategy and roadmap in collaboration with leadership, covering activation, engagement, and retention
  • Own CRM execution for utilization-based and strategic accounts: design, build, QA, launch, and optimize custom journeys in Braze
  • Track member utilization and engagement against contractual targets, and adjust programs to close gaps
  • Partner with Client Success and account teams to tailor programs to client population, goals, and commitments at scale
  • Build the foundational infrastructure for the scaled book, including base Canvas architecture, client-level segmentation, and dynamic content frameworks, so the Manager can operate it at volume
  • Own the data and segmentation architecture, including custom attributes and events and how org-level context drives personalization
  • Run the experimentation program: hypotheses, test design, readouts, and roadmap decisions
  • Pilot new approaches with priority accounts, then hand proven plays to the Manager to scale across the book
  • Set standards for Canvas architecture, naming conventions, and measurement
  • Manage, coach, and develop the CRM Manager: set priorities, give feedback, and decide when requests from the broader book warrant custom work
  • Own the performance narrative for senior leadership
  • Coordinate with Product, Data/Analytics, Legal/Compliance, and the D2C CRM team

What you need to have

  • 7+ years in CRM or lifecycle marketing with deep, hands-on Braze expertise (Canvas, Liquid, Connected Content, segmentation, event-driven triggers)
  • A record of defining strategy and personally building and shipping it
  • Experience managing a small portfolio of performance-linked accounts where CRM outcomes affect contract results
  • Experience managing or mentoring others, formally or informally
  • Comfort with SQL and analytics tools (Snowflake, Amplitude), and the ability to turn data into decisions
  • Strong presence with senior stakeholders and cross-functional influence
  • Experience with B2B2C, benefits, or health-adjacent products (preferred)
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and privacy-conscious data practices (preferred)

How success is measured

  • Utilization and engagement outcomes for utilization-based and strategic accounts
  • A clear, adopted roadmap
  • A sound, scalable Braze architecture that the Manager can run
  • Proven plays that get successfully scaled
  • The growth and effectiveness of your direct report

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range

Job Title: Senior Payroll Specialist

Job Location: Budapest, Hungary

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Veeva Systems EMEA Payroll team is hiring a Senior Payroll Specialist to join our growing, high-performance team. In this dynamic role, you will be the captain of your own ship, taking true end-to-end ownership of managing, processing, and reconciling multi-country payrolls using modern tools and systems.

Supported by accessible leadership and a highly collaborative culture, you will tackle complex challenges while ensuring strict adherence to local statutory compliance, tax laws, and internal controls. Serving as a trusted advisor to cross-functional partners, you’ll leverage your individual agility to drive continuous growth, seamless operational delivery, and exceptional employee support across the region.

What You'll Do

    • Own and execute the end-to-end payroll process for several European countries, ensuring accuracy and timeliness across all pay cycles (on-cycle and off-cycle)
    • Audit, validate, and reconcile complex payroll data against source files, ensuring complete accuracy and compliance before final approval
    • Advise and align with internal stakeholders (HR, Finance, and Employee Success) and external service providers to deliver expert advisory support on complex compliance and payroll matters, ensuring data accuracy and proper employee classification
    • Master and implement evolving EU payroll tax regulations, proactively safeguarding regional compliance standards and mitigating risk
    • Spearhead process improvement initiatives, architecting new workflows and driving successful regional adoption

Requirements

    • 7+ years of professional payroll experience in a fast-paced, multi-national environment handling EMEA payroll
    • Strong knowledge of EU payroll tax regulations, social contributions, and statutory compliance requirements
    • High attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, fast-learning ability, and a collaborative, customer-first approach
    • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet strict deadlines in a dynamic business environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English to effectively collaborate with internal and external partners
    • Proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Office products with advanced Microsoft Excel functions

Nice to Have

    • HRIS & Payroll Systems: Hands-on experience with major global HRIS and ERP systems (e.g., Workday or NetSuite)
    • Professional Certification: Recognized payroll or accounting qualification (e.g., CIPP, Certified Payroll Professional, or regional equivalent)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical Cover
    • Cafeteria
    • Pension Plan

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 10,500,000 - 16,500,000 HUF
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. raw.description:
Join One of the Fastest-Growing Online Education Companies in the World

At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

Now we're looking for a highly organized and creative Instructional Designer to help us bring exceptional online learning experiences to life. If you're passionate about education, thrive in a collaborative environment, and enjoy turning ideas into impactful courses, we'd love to meet you.

Why This Role Is Different

At ELVTR, you'll work at the intersection of education, innovation, and collaboration. You'll partner with industry-leading instructors and cross-functional teams to develop engaging online courses that help professionals around the world advance their careers.

From the earliest stages of course planning through production and launch, you'll play a key role in ensuring every learning experience meets our high standards for quality, relevance, and learner engagement.

You'll Love This Role If You:

  • Enjoy managing projects from concept to completion
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Love working with experts and helping bring their knowledge to life
  • Enjoy solving problems and finding creative solutions
  • Stay curious about learning, education, and emerging technologies
  • Believe education has the power to transform careers and lives

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate the end-to-end production of live online courses, from planning through launch
  • Conduct market research and help define course objectives, learning outcomes, and target audiences
  • Manage production timelines, priorities, and deliverables to ensure projects stay on schedule
  • Partner closely with instructors, guiding them through course preparation and rehearsals
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, Sales, and Student Success teams to deliver high-quality learning experiences
  • Review course materials, marketing content, and sales collateral for clarity, accuracy, and educational value
  • Identify and resolve production challenges while maintaining project momentum
  • Stay informed about industry trends, instructional design best practices, and emerging learning technologies
  • Continuously share ideas and feedback to improve our courses and production processes

Requirements

  • Experience in instructional design, course production, project management, or a related field
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities
  • Outstanding English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Comfortable collaborating with senior professionals and subject matter experts
  • Ability to work independently while thriving in a remote, collaborative environment
  • Flexibility to collaborate across multiple time zones
  • Passion for education, lifelong learning, and creating engaging learning experiences
  • Experience with online education or EdTech is a plus

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation:Competitive salary,Performance-based bonuses,Opportunities for career advancement as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow:Free access to ELVTR courses,Ongoing professional development opportunities,Career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, Flexible and supportive work environment,Collaborative international team
  • Health & Wellbeing:Gym membership reimbursement,Mental health support, Generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact:Every course you help create empowers professionals to build new skills, advance their careers, and unlock opportunities they never thought possible.
  • Grow Your Career:We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.
  • Join a Winning Team:Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another instructional design role—if you want to collaborate with industry experts, create meaningful educational experiences, and make a lasting impact on learners around the world—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

ELVTR is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all.
