Position: Senior Executive Assistant | AI & Business Operations

Salary: Php 50,000 to Php 65,000/monthly

Working Hours & Conditions: 9am to 5pm - NZ Working Hours and Holidays

Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is a leading New Zealand film and content production company, bringing ambitious creative ideas to life through high-end commercials, television productions, documentaries, and branded content.

Based in Auckland, the company combines world-class production talent, cutting-edge technology, and a highly collaborative creative environment. From directors and production crews to specialist camera systems, virtual production, and post-production, the business is built around delivering exceptional work for agencies and brands.

We're creative, energetic, innovative, and always moving. We embrace new technology, think outside the box, and value people who bring personality, initiative, and fresh ideas to the table.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a confident, highly organised, and tech-savvy Senior Executive Assistant | AI & Business Operations to become a trusted right hand to the company's leadership team.

This is far from a typical administrative role. You will take ownership of day-to-day executive support, keep communication flowing, maintain key client relationships, and ensure the business continues running smoothly when leadership is travelling, meeting clients, or out on set. A major component of this role involves leveraging the company's existing AI-powered operating systems and knowledge base to streamline workflows and work smarter, faster, and more effectively.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Executive Support & Inbox Management

  • Take complete ownership of executive inboxes, ensuring emails are reviewed, prioritised, and actioned efficiently.
  • Draft professional, engaging, and accurate responses using the company's established tone of voice, independently or using Claude AI.
  • Identify urgent matters, escalate critical communications, and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
  • Manage executive calendars, schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and ensure leadership is thoroughly prepared for upcoming commitments.
  • Serve as a reliable point of contact when executives are travelling, on set, or unavailable.

AI Systems & Workflow Optimisation

  • Confidently utilize Claude and the company’s existing AI-powered operating systems to support daily business operations.
  • Leverage the company’s AI knowledge base to prepare communications, retrieve information, and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Stay informed about emerging AI tools and propose continuous improvements to operational efficiency and workflows.
  • Maintain accuracy, confidentiality, and sound judgment when working with AI-generated outputs.

Travel, Events & Logistics Coordination

  • Research, coordinate, and book domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, and itineraries.
  • Research and organize crew outings, team events, client lunches, agency meetings, and relationship-building functions.
  • Liaise with venues, suppliers, and service providers, managing changing schedules with a flexible, solutions-focused approach.

Client & Agency Relationship Management

  • Maintain regular communication and conduct professional outreach check-ins with existing clients, advertising agencies, and key business contacts.
  • Support business development efforts through proactive follow-ups, introductions, and relationship nurturing.
  • Track conversations, opportunities, and follow-up actions within monday.com to ensure no business development opportunities are missed during busy production cycles.

CRM & Business Administration

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date contact records, communication logs, and activity tracking in monday.com.
  • Organize and maintain administrative information, documents, and records across evolving business priorities.
  • Provide comprehensive meeting preparation, research, and general business coordination.

Internal Communication & Team Coordination

  • Act as a seamless communication link between leadership, internal teams, production, creative, and operational staff.
  • Ensure important messages reach the appropriate stakeholders promptly, particularly when leadership is on location or travelling.
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential scheduling or communication bottlenecks to support a positive, collaborative environment.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated Experience: Proven background as an Executive Assistant, Senior Virtual Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar business support role.
  • Core Administration Skills: Advanced experience managing high-volume executive inboxes, calendars, complex travel logistics, and client communications.
  • AI & Technical Capability: Strong familiarity with AI tools (specifically Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable platforms) and comfort operating within an established AI-driven environment.
  • Platform Proficiency: Hands-on experience using CRM or project management platforms (ideally monday.com).
  • Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate naturally and professionally with New Zealand clients and stakeholders.
  • Schedule Alignment: Full availability to work full-time during New Zealand business hours and holidays.
  • Professional Attributes: High level of discretion, strong organizational skills, self-direction, and acute attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Previous experience directly supporting founders, directors, or senior executives.
  • Prior experience working with New Zealand or Australian businesses.
  • Background within a creative agency, film production, advertising, media, or marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with client relationship management, business development support, or outbound outreach.
  • Exposure to AI automation tools, workflow design, or productivity software.
  • Design or content skills using tools such as Canva or presentation software.
  • Experience organizing corporate events, client functions, or team activities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Personality & Energy: A fun, vibrant, and engaging presence with a great sense of humor and positive energy that complements a creative workplace culture.
  • Confidence & Wit: An outgoing, "cheeky" personality who is comfortable speaking up, asking questions, following up with stakeholders, and bringing fresh ideas.
  • Proactivity & Initiative: A forward-thinking, resourceful mindset that anticipates executive needs, solves problems independently, and challenges inefficient processes.
  • Tech Curiosity: A genuine interest in AI, automation, and modern technologies, viewing digital tools as an opportunity to amplify capabilities.
  • Dependability & Adaptability: Absolute reliability in managing critical tasks end-to-end, coupled with the agility to navigate unpredictable schedules in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commercial Awareness: A strong understanding of the business impact of relationship management, timely follow-ups, and brand representation.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

The Team:

The CrowdStrike Intelligence Editorial team—part of Intelligence Publishing—works closely with analysts, writers, engineers, and creative services to produce high-quality, impactful, and competitive CrowdStrike Intelligence.


The Role:

Key Senior Technical Editor Responsibilities include:


Editorial Excellence & Quality Assurance


  • Upholding Editorial Standards: Perform thorough developmental, copy, and substantive edits on intelligence reports, uphold rigorous grammatical and editorial standards, and adhere to the CrowdStrike Intelligence Style Guide and established checklists.
  • Providing Objective Justiﬁcation: Apply deep theoretical English-language knowledge and practical editing expertise to provide clear, constructive, and objective reasoning for editorial revisions.
  • Producing High-Impact Deliverables: Participate equally with senior peers in producing error-free, time-sensitive, and broadly impactful intelligence products.
  • Paying Attention to Detail: Catch subtle errors, discrepancies, and formatting nuances that others miss to ensure comprehensive quality control before publication.

Publishing & Workﬂow Operations


  • Managing Queues & Schedules: Adhere to publishing workﬂows, product schedules, checklists, and collaborative queue management to guarantee on-time delivery of intelligence deliverables.
  • Negotiating with Stakeholders: Model effective diplomacy and negotiation with analysts and production stakeholders during editorial review cycles to achieve clarity without compromising editorial integrity.
  • Demonstrating Systems Proﬁciency: Model near-mastery of publishing platforms and procedural workﬂows; identify and resolve potential interruptions to publication.
  • Incorporating AI: Use available or develop tools to assist with and enhance processes where appropriate.

Problem Solving & Critical Thinking


  • Executing Tasks with Independence: Perform day-to-day editorial tasks with minimal direction; apply sound judgment within established policies, precedents, and procedures.
  • Resolving Issues: Tackle problems of moderate scope, analyze variable factors, and adapt learned techniques to eliminate publication bottlenecks.
  • Developing Skills: Pitch, develop, ﬁne tune, and implement team and department-wide professional development, resource building, and improvement initiatives.

Collaboration, Communication, & Professionalism


  • Building Cross-Functional Partnerships: Develop productive working relationships with analysts, core analysis cells, editorial peers, and management to advance the CAO mission and deliver mutual solutions.
  • Communicating Clearly and Proactively: Communicate effectively with management regarding project updates and needed support; track communication threads to maintain organized delivery across concurrent tasks.
  • Uplifting and Mentoring Teammates: Provide on-the-job training for junior editors and new hires, share technical knowledge, and contribute to team skill-reﬁnement and resource-development initiatives.
  • Maintaining Objectivity and Composure: Serve as a reliable, steady point of contact during high-stress situations, resolve professional disagreements constructively and objectively, and ensure personal preferences never compromise publishing standards.

Required Qualiﬁcations & Experience


  • Education & Experience:
  • Master’s Degree in a relevant ﬁeld
  • Language and Style Mastery: Exceptional command of the English language (grammar, mechanics, style, and syntax) with proven experience editing under structured corporate or technical style guides.
  • Continuous Improvement: Self-starter mindset with a commitment to continuous professional development.

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

raw.description:
Budgeting & Forecasting Specialist – FP&A, Financial Modeling & Variance Analysis | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Budgeting & Forecasting Specialist to own financial planning, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.

This is a hands-on FP&A role focused on building reliable budgets and forecasts, analyzing business performance, and providing forward-looking insights that help leadership make better decisions.

You’ll partner with finance leaders and department heads to ensure financial plans are accurate, realistic, and aligned with business strategy.

What You’ll Own

Budgeting & Financial Planning

  • Lead preparation of annual operating and capital budgets
  • Consolidate financial inputs across departments and business units
  • Align budgets with company goals, operational plans, and resource constraints
  • Partner with department leaders to validate assumptions and spending plans

Forecasting & Scenario Planning

  • Maintain rolling forecasts for:
    • Revenue
    • Expenses
    • Cash flow
  • Update forecasts with actual results and revised assumptions
  • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to evaluate potential outcomes
  • Identify emerging financial risks and opportunities

Variance Analysis

  • Compare actual performance against budgets and forecasts
  • Identify key drivers behind financial variances
  • Prepare clear written commentary for leadership
  • Recommend corrective actions based on performance trends

Financial Modeling

  • Build dynamic financial models using Excel and Google Sheets
  • Develop models for:
    • DCF
    • ROI
    • IRR
    • Break-even analysis
    • Scenario planning
  • Use advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros, and data integrations to improve modeling efficiency and accuracy

Reporting & Executive Insights

  • Prepare management reporting packages, dashboards, and visualizations
  • Translate complex financial data into clear business insights
  • Present risks, opportunities, trends, and recommendations to leadership
  • Support strategic and operational decision-making with financial analysis

FP&A Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in budgeting and forecasting workflows
  • Improve planning cycles, data inputs, and reporting processes
  • Support implementation or optimization of FP&A platforms such as:
    • Anaplan
    • Adaptive Insights
    • Workday
    • Hyperion

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, or financial analysis experience
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Nested formulas
    • Pivot tables
    • Sensitivity modeling
    • Financial modeling
  • Experience building and maintaining budgets and rolling forecasts
  • Experience preparing variance analysis and commentary for leadership
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to build financial models from scratch
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Comfortable working independently during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Hyperion, Workday, or similar FP&A tools
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
  • MBA, CFA, or CPA
  • Experience in SaaS, real estate, or professional services
  • Experience improving or automating forecasting processes

What Success Looks Like

  • Forecast accuracy maintained within approximately ±5–10%
  • Budgets completed accurately and on schedule
  • Variance explanations delivered within 2–3 days of close
  • Financial models remain accurate and consistently updated
  • Leadership receives clear, actionable financial insights
  • Forecasting cycle time improves through automation and process optimization

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Financial Modeling & Sensitivity Analysis Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re an FP&A professional who excels at budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, variance analysis, and turning financial data into actionable business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

About Working at Commerce

Building a career here is more than just steps on a ladder. It’s about helping people find financial safety and success, helping businesses thrive, and making sure people and their money are taken care of. And our commitment doesn’t stop there. Our culture is about our people, the ones in our communities and the ones that work with us.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow and learn, to connect with others, and build relationships with the people around you. You’ll have the space and resources to grow into the best version of yourself. Because our number one investment is you.

Creating an award-winning culture doesn't come easy. And after 160 years, we know Commerce Bank is only at its best when our people are. If this sounds interesting to you, keep reading and let’s talk.


Compensation Range

Annual Salary: $136,850.00 - $233,000.00 (Amount based on relevant experience, skills, and competencies.)

About This Job


The main purpose of this job is to be involved in both the comprehensive management of existing commercial relationships as well as solicit new business opportunities with assigned customers and targeted prospects. Although it can vary by market, targeted companies generally include those with annual sales of $50MM and over.


Essential Functions

  • Coordinate with assigned customers and targeted prospects with the objective to acquire new business
  • Serve as the primary advisor for an assigned portfolio of diverse and complex commercial relationships, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and retention
  • Coordinate with product partners to cross-sell a full range of products and services
  • Critically review and analyze portfolio to reduce risk and enhance profitability
  • Facilitate credit requests, including loan structuring, negotiating/pricing, collateral, ensuring adequate loan documentation, and analyzing industry/credit risk
  • Facilitate the resolution of customer problems, engaging product experts as needed
  • Participate in community and business functions/groups to ensure a positive image for the bank and to establish referral contacts within the marketplace
  • Ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, regulations, and laws
  • Manage a portfolio of commercial relationships with some or all of the following characteristics:
    • Average loan portfolio O/S of $100MM to $150MM
    • Average deposit portfolio of $50MM to $100MM
    • Annual contribution of $750M to $1.5MM
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

  • Strong knowledge of full range of commercial products, credit policies, procedures, and terminology
  • Ability to maintain a valid driver’s license and meet Commerce Bank’s driving record criteria; ongoing employment may be contingent upon meeting all driving requirements
  • Strong time management skills, with ability to appropriately prioritize calling activities and strategies
  • Goal oriented with well-developed sales skills
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to mentor and provide leadership to junior roles
  • Experienced at structuring complex credit requests
  • Motivated and organized self-starter with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Inquisitive, agile and strong team player with excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to remain adaptable and resilient to all situations with an optimistic outlook and cast a positive shadow that is aligned with our culture and Core Values
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience required
  • 8+ years of commercial banking experience required

For this position, federal regulations require Commerce Bank to prepare an investigatory consumer report which will disclose credit history. If you express interest in and are considered for this position, you will be asked to authorize that report.


For this position, Commerce Bank will review your motor vehicle driving record. If you express interest in and are considered for this position, you’ll be asked to authorize our review of that record.


**Level of role is determined by knowledge, experience, skills, abilities, and education


***For individuals applying, assigned and/or hired to work in areas with pay transparency requirements, Commerce is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for some roles. This compensation range is for the Commercial Banking Relationship Manager III and Senior job and contemplates a wide range of factors that are considered in determining most appropriate job level and making compensation decisions, including but not limited to location, skill sets, education, relevant experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has been adjusted for any applicable differentials (geographic, bilingual, or shift) that could be associated with the position or where it is filled. At Commerce, compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each situation. A reasonable estimate of the current base pay is $136,850 to $233,000 annually. This position will be eligible for additional compensation through performance-based incentive plan(s) that will correspond to meeting performance goals.


Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship now or in the future.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

As a Specialist Sales Manager, NG SIEM/Logscale, you will have the exciting opportunity to help promote the growth and shape the future of the Next-Gen SIEM and Log Management business at CrowdStrike. You will combine your relevant technology sales experience with solid industry insight to successfully position our industry-leading NG SIEM and log management platform to our top Enterprise customers– articulating and demonstrating business value/ROI. Your job is to build out your territory and maximize market adoption. In return, this position offers uncapped income potential in one of the most strategic, fastest-growing segments of the technology industry and an opportunity to join a company at the forefront of establishing de facto leadership in this market.


Must live in GA/FL Region in order to be considered!


What You'll Do:

  • Identify, develop, and execute account strategy to close new business opportunities and expanding revenue with customers across the assigned region; independently and cooperatively.
  • Scope, negotiate, and bring to closure agreements to exceed booking and revenue quota targets.
  • Target and gain access to decision makers in key prospect accounts in the assigned territory.
  • Establish access and maintain existing relationships with key decision makers (typically at the CIO and CSO level) in industry, partners, and enterprise customers to drive all pertinent issues related to sales strategy and goal attainment.
  • Collaborate with peers with cross-functional teams (including the Field Sales, Channels & Alliances, Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, Services, Customer Support, and Product Management) to create visibility with target accounts and drive engagement of prospects at both the individual contributor and executive level.
  • Work cooperatively with partners to leverage their established account presence and relationships.
  • Capture, maintain, and disseminate accurate and relevant prospect information using Salesforce.com.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of high achievement selling enterprise platform solutions into one of the following markets (SIEM, log management, cybersecurity, observability, data analytics, or data management).
  • Ability to adapt, thrive and excel in a fast-moving, nimble environment.
  • Strong presentation skills and ability to skillfully interact with technical stakeholders as well as executive decision makers.
  • Success in owning and running the entire sales cycle from lead generation to close with a disciplined approach / methodology (MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Challenger, Sandler, etc).
  • Comfortable in team selling environment working in close collaboration with peers in the CrowdStrike sales organization.
  • History and reputable track record of exceeding goals and sales quotas – high achiever!
  • Consultative sales approach – ability to challenge companies/businesses to think differently.
  • Strength in evangelizing technology and new account acquisition (hunting) – ability to discover and uncover new opportunities with prospects and existing business customers.
  • Highly motivated and professional, with excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and complete multiple tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Self-starter able to work independently but also team oriented – work together, win together attitude.
  • Excellent problem resolution skills – resourceful and constructive.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.

If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at further assistance.

Find out more about your rights as an applicant.

CrowdStrike participates in the E-Verify program.

Notice of E-Verify Participation

Right to Work

CrowdStrike, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Placement within the pay range is dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications, job level, supervisory status, and location. The base salary range for this position for all U.S. candidates is $105,000 - $163,000 per year, with eligibility for commissions, equity grants and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, 401k and paid time off.

raw.description:
Position: Account Manager

﻿Job Location: Remote

﻿Job Type: Part time/Full time

Company Overview:

Brandcoven is a leading brand management agency that specializes in helping businesses build and maintain strong and impactful brands. We work with a diverse range of clients from various industries to create unique and effective brand strategies that drive growth and success. Our team consists of experienced professionals who are passionate about branding and dedicated to delivering exceptional results for our clients.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Manager to join our team. As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and developing relationships with our clients, understanding their business needs and goals, and working with our team to deliver effective branding solutions. This is a full-time remote position based in the United States.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, building and maintaining strong relationships
  • Understand and analyze clients' business objectives and develop effective brand strategies to help them achieve their goals
  • Collaborate with our team to develop creative and innovative branding solutions
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and ensure timely delivery of high-quality work
  • Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to clients
  • Proactively identify and address any issues or challenges that may arise during projects
  • Conduct market research and stay updated on industry trends to provide valuable insights to clients
  • Prepare and present reports and presentations to clients, showcasing project results and recommendations
  • Continuously seek opportunities to upsell and expand our services to existing clients
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to drive growth for the company

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in account management, preferably in a branding or marketing agency
  • Proven track record of successfully managing client relationships and delivering results
  • Strong understanding of branding principles and strategies
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently
  • Willingness to travel for client meetings and events as needed

We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic and talented team

- Remote work flexibility

  • Professional development and growth opportunities
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment

If you are a driven and results-oriented individual with a passion for branding, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join our team at Brandcoven as an Account Manager and be a part of creating impactful and successful brands for our clients.

raw.description:
Releaf (www.releaf.co.uk) is an innovative, regulated online medical cannabis clinic serving 20,000+

patients. We specialise in the fast, efficient delivery of high-quality medication and exceptional patient

care. We are a company of around 170 people, and we are building the finance function that will take

the business to its next stage of scale.

We are an AI-first finance team. We have rolled out Claude across the finance function, and it is already

part of how we produce Board packs, investor updates, analysis and reviews. We are looking for

someone who will take that further, not someone we need to convince.

Role overview

We are hiring an FP&A Manager to own financial planning, forecasting and performance reporting

across the group. This is the first dedicated FP&A role at Releaf. A target plan and commercial models

are already in place. You will take ownership of their preparation, develop them into a full driver-based

planning model, and set the standard for how planning and reporting work as we scale.

You will report to the Finance & Commercial Director and work directly with the CFO and the Board,

with no direct reports initially. Within your first year you will own the preparation of the budget, the

rolling forecast, the monthly performance and Board packs, and the group cash flow model. The Group

Finance Manager owns month-end close, accounting policy, accruals and the statutory audit; you will

provide forecast and commercial inputs to the close, and work closely with them on reconciled

numbers.

This role suits someone with at least three years post-qualification experience who has done FP&A inside a

larger business, or a business that has scaled, and now wants the whole discipline rather than a slice of

it. You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work, you have opinions on where they help and where

they do not, and you are energised rather than alarmed by a business with ambitions to grow

substantially from its current level.

How the finance team uses AI today

Claude is in daily use across the finance team. Current uses include:

  • Board packs: drafting and reviewing commentary, checking the numbers tie through, and

challenging the narrative before it goes to the Board

  • Investor updates: building investor materials and update packs from the underlying model
  • Analysis and modelling: variance analysis, cohort and unit economics work, scenario

modelling and model review

  • Contracts and commercial: first-pass review of supplier, manufacturing and commercial

agreements, with the risks flagged for a human decision

  • Operational finance: reconciliations, month-on-month file comparisons, working papers and

data clean-up

The FP&A Manager will be expected to use these tools from the first week, and to make them a

standard, documented part of how planning and reporting get done.

Key responsibilities

1. Planning, budgeting and forecasting

  • Own the development process and preparation of the annual budget and the quarterly re-forecast,

built on business drivers

  • Own the preparation and reporting of the rolling three-month revenue and gross margin forecast,

and be accountable for its accuracy

  • Own the preparation of the group cashflow forecast, including working capital, stock purchasing and

intercompany flows across the Group

  • Support the Finance & Commercial Director on target-setting, and report performance against both

budget and target

  • Build scenario and sensitivity analysis into the planning process so the Board sees a range, not a

single line

2. Performance reporting and the Board pack

  • Own the production of the monthly performance reporting pack end to end — revenue, gross

margin, cost of sales, overheads, cash and the operational KPIs that drive them

  • Prepare the monthly Board pack and slide deck, including commentary, for review and sign-off by

the Finance & Commercial Director. Use AI to speed up drafting and review, while remaining

accountable for the accuracy of every number

  • Own the monthly cost of sales analysis and the margin bridge — price, volume, mix, discount,

freight and fulfilment

  • Report on the commercial performance of the international entities as they become material
  • Issue a mid-month flash on revenue, gross margin and cash ahead of the full pack
  • Support investor updates with consistent, reconciled numbers and clear narrative

3. Finance data, systems and AI

  • Own the design, development and maintenance of a single, governed finance data warehouse,

bringing together Xero, Spendesk, Stripe and Releafs ERP, so the finance team can use reliable

data in reporting, analysis and AI models. This includes data quality, reconciliation to the ledger,

access controls and the exclusion or anonymisation of patient-identifiable data

  • Own the implementation and management of AI initiatives across the finance team. Set the

roadmap with the Finance & Commercial Director and CFO, build AI into planning and reporting,

and deliver reusable workflows, including prompts for variance commentary, the flash, pack review,

reconciliations and data preparation. Train the team and measure the time released and accuracy

gained

  • Lead the automation of reporting across Xero, Spendesk, Stripe and Releafs own ERP, replacing

manual consolidation with something that runs

  • Working with the Group Finance Manager, identify where AI can remove manual effort from the

close and reporting cycle, deliver it, and measure the time it releases

  • Set and apply sensible guardrails for AI use in finance — human review of outputs, a clear audit

trail, and the right handling of commercially sensitive and patient-related data in a regulated

healthcare business

  • Map and upgrade the end-to-end planning and reporting workflow; document controls,

assumptions, AI workflows and change logs

4. Commercial partnering

  • Own unit economics and cohort analysis (CAC, LTV, retention) to support commercial and

marketing decisions

  • Translate the numbers for non-finance leaders, and be willing to challenge them
  • Support the Finance & Commercial Director on departmental cost analysis and budgeting for

Marketing, Clinic, Operations and IT

  • Contribute to business cases and investment appraisal
  • Help colleagues outside finance get more from AI for their own reporting and analysis

What success looks like in year one

  • A trusted planning model. A driver-based budget and rolling three-month revenue and gross

margin forecast that the Board uses to make decisions, with forecast accuracy measured and

reported every month.

  • A Board and management pack that runs like clockwork. The monthly performance and Board

packs land on a fixed date.

  • Full cash visibility. A group cashflow forecast that gives the Board a reliable view of cash and

working capital across the Company.

  • A finance data and AI foundation. A governed data warehouse in live use, manual consolidation

removed, and documented AI workflows with the hours they release measured.

Requirements

Essential

  • Fully qualified ACA, ACCA or CIMA with at least three years post-qualification experience
  • Demonstrable ownership of budgeting, forecasting and management or Board reporting — not
    •

support of someone else's

  • Demonstrable production of Board packs and presentation of financial performance to senior

leadership, with clear, decision-focused commentary

  • Advanced Excel: driver-based modelling, including with large datasets. You should be able to build

a three-statement or driver model from scratch

  • Hands-on, current experience of using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot in

your own finance work — for example drafting Board or management commentary, building and

checking models, analysing large datasets, reviewing documents or automating reporting. You will

be asked to walk us through real examples at interview

  • Sound judgement on AI output: you know where it is reliable, where it is not, and you check before

you rely on it

  • A track record of building or materially improving a reporting process, ideally through automation

and AI

  • Experience structuring and managing finance data for reporting or analytics
  • Evidence that your analysis has changed a decision, with the number attached
  • Confident communicating with and challenging senior non-finance stakeholders
  • Comfortable with incomplete data and imperfect systems, and inclined to go and fix them
    •

Desirable

  • Experience building repeatable AI workflows rather than one-off prompts — shared prompt libraries,

AI connected to finance systems or data, or AI-assisted automation of a reporting cycle

  • SME or scale-up experience — you will recognise the difference between a process that is broken

and one that has simply not been built yet

• Multi-entity or group reporting

  • Xero, Spendesk, Stripe; Power BI or equivalent; SQL or Python
  • Stock, cost of sales or supply-chain-intensive experience
  • Healthcare, pharmacy, e-commerce or another regulated sector, including handling sensitive data
    •

responsibly

  • Involvement in an ERP or reporting system implementation

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed annually, plus a performance-related bonus

• Private health insurance and pension

  • Funded professional subscription (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) and a personalised development budget
  • Full access to Claude and the finance teams AI tooling from day one, and the time and backing to
    •

build with it

  • Remote working with occasional UK travel, and the flexibility to structure your own week
  • Employee Assistance Programme, employee perks and Releaf staff patient benefits
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and the Board from month one
  • The chance to build an AI-enabled function rather than inherit a manual one
    •

How to apply

Please send a CV and a short covering note answering four questions, in bullet points or a few short

paragraphs:

1. What attracts you to Releaf and to this role in particular?

2. Which parts of your experience map most directly onto the responsibilities above?

3. Tell us about one piece of analysis or reporting you produced that changed a decision. What was

the decision, and what changed?

4. How do you use AI in your current role today? Give one specific example of a finance task you now

do differently because of it, and how you checked the output.

Selection process

  • Stage 1: an informal remote conversation.
  • Stage 2: a second interview in person. We will discuss your written response to this job description
    •

and work through examples of how you would tackle them.

  • Stage 3: an in-person presentation. You may choose either a case study we provide or a piece of

your own work, anonymised as needed. Your presentation should cover the data analysis, how you

used AI to produce it and how you checked the output, and Board-level commentary on what the

numbers mean and what should happen next. Allow 20 minutes to present and 20 minutes for

questions.

AI at interview: every candidate will be asked about their use of AI. Expect to talk through real

examples from your current work, and to show us how you would use Claude on a typical FP&A

task such as drafting variance commentary or reviewing a forecast.

We are an inclusive employer and welcome applications from a diverse range of candidates. If there is

anything we can do to support you through the process, please tell us.
